title: Xmas present - Xmas passed !

In the event they did not appear by 2 pm on Xmas Eve so checked the couriers website where it stated items ordered on 22nd would not be delivered til 27th .This was not made clear at point of ordering on Axminster site or I would have attempted to visit my local store instead but it was too late for that by the time I found this information on the courier website. Despite payment being taken - a full forty eight hours before and 24th given as delivery date on my order confirmation .My husband didn’t get his present . Goods arrived on 27th and were as described . I complained and received a delivery charge refund and a 10% discount for next order but please don’t promise what you can’t deliver especially at Xmas .Santa not impressed you’re on the naughty list . Update : 3/1/25 Stephanie from Customer Services has responded to me directly which I appreciate and the discount offered off another purchase is welcome . I hope my experience was just an isolated  “IT” hiccup over the Xmas period . I’m not put off ordering from Axminster again as the products were good and my husband was ultimately pleased with them so I’ve now added a star for Customer Services.

description:
Aluminium Scaffold Towers Limited manufactures and sells top quality Scaffold Towers. We are an ISO9001 accredited manufacturer – one of the very few to achieve EN 1004-1:2020 Standard certification for mobile scaffold towers. The company takes pride in its range of scaffold tower products, all of which are manufactured to the highest quality as well as meeting exacting industry safety standards.

As safety standards within the industry have increased, so we have increased the quality of all our product designs to match:-
The DIY tower incorporates welded frames, quick locking braces and advanced guard railing – with options for height adjustable base plates or height adjustable castor wheels. All of these are new innovations in the DIY market and are made to the same high standards used in our other (trade) ranges.

For our TUV GS marked trade tower the focus is strongly on keeping weight to a minimum whilst maintaining rigidity, strength and safety. The trade tower also offers substantially greater working height capacity (9.65m) than any other tower in its class.

On our industrial tower (TUV GS marked) we have made installation even easier by redesigning and reducing the weight of the toe board, to further enhance a product that has already been sold in its thousands across the UK.

Safety is our top priority – always! Every tower we sell has been manufactured to the rigorous quality and the same standard of manufacture required by top European approval bodies such as BSI and TUV in Germany.

We are committed to the highest levels of customer service and to ensuring that all our customers receive the best possible advice to select the product that is most applicable to their needs. To this end all our sales staff are qualified as PASMA mobile scaffold tower erectors – so they understand your issues – as well as offering in-depth product knowledge gained through training at our manufacturing plant.

We value innovation and ensure that our products are continuously improved to meet the ever-changing needs and challenges of our customers.

We are very confident you will be delighted with our products – so confident that we offer an unconditional no quibble, 5 year manufacturers guarantee on all our towers, against manufacturing defects on every Loyal tower we sell.

Our mortgage was due to expire 07/02/23 and Avant let us complete 06/02/23. Our house wasn’t quite complete but we were luckily in a position to wait a little longer to move. (We moved 09.02.23). Zehra at head office was always the most helpful with pushing things or getting us answers. Since we moved in the site team have been fantastic. Site managers (Tom and Steve) often knocked when we first moved in to ask how we were getting on and if we needed anything. They still stop if they see us on the front and will ask if we need anything and act on it when we do. Site team are just really friendly and helpful too. Like taking rubbish away for us when we had no bins or cardboard away when we recently build the shed. We paid a professional snagger and he was impressed with the standard of the house and said we had less snags then he would expect. title: Rushed to finish - waterside quarter, chesterfield
review: This is really a review of a few different parts, each of which are broken down below.The good…Sales, the support and advice throughout the sales/buying process was fantastic, helpful, polite, customer focused, always returned calls and emails. Hard to find any fault.The property itself, well designed and spacious, with each area feeling useful and like they got the most out of it.The bad…Part way through the build the spec was changed, some changes were made (albeit small ones) that made no sense, for example there was an area above the hob on the extraction with two cupboard doors, inside these were three small shelves, perfect for cooking spices….. on the “new spec” the cupboard doors are still there… but two of the shelves aren’t, rendering it not only useless but also pointless.  There are some other small things like this that it would have been nice to be informed about, I’m still baffled as to why they did this.The ugly…A lot of work was done the two days before I got the keys….. and I honestly wish they had kept the keys for another week!!! It was obvious the last few days were a rush job, the finish was absolutely lousy! The paint looked in areas like it had been put on with a mop and bucket!!! I could go into a lot of detail here, but I’ve gone over the issues that many times now with the “customer care” team that I get tired just thinking about it!The joy of a new build is supposed to be the convenience of moving your stuff in and starting to live, not to have to spend days waiting in for tradesmen to not bother turning up, hours on calls that go unreturned, months waiting for optional extras that were missed originally and are seemingly next to impossible to acquire. It’s made it difficult to settle and enjoy the place when you have to empty rooms and wardrobes etc out again so they can be put in to the condition that they should have been when they were handed over.

title: The good and the bad
review: We love our house on Alma Place, it’s a gorgeous house and we have loved making it our home. The initial sales team worked well with us to secure our home, however, if you are reaching the end of the month when you’re due to complete and your solicitors aren’t quite ready, they will be very pushy and advise that they may have to forfeit your sale if it isn’t completed. We ended up spending an extra £1,000 to swap to their solicitors to ensure we were completed for them to meet their deadlines. Avant fixed our initial issues very quickly, including being plumed into hot water instead of cold etc, however, we have been fighting for some drainage on our drive since March, which was subsequently agreed and now there is ‘no record of this’ and the people we have spoken to have either ‘left’ or are ‘off sick’. We have tried to contact customer services multiple times via email and are met with no response. Our neighbours are also having the same issue. We have had issues with the site staff using our property for their equipment and making a mess from the site and this has not been rectified either. I am currently trying to speak with them regarding our heating system as that’s not working properly either… and we’ve only been in 6 months. You will find you really like your home, however the aftercare team do no such thing as ‘aftercare’. I’ve felt blatantly ignored, and even when I’ve had reassurance that I’m not being, I don’t believe it. Be wary is all I will say, and take it all with a pinch of salt.

title: Great product, operates solid and smoothly
review: Wanted to order rotating butterfly latches in black. Website had an "Enquire" link, which we did. Response was simply "Unfortunately, we don’t stock the L0965/LK in Australia.". No alternatives offered. Browsing the website again saw the chrome ones (L0965/L) were available to be ordered online, so did that. Arrived in a timely manner and installed with little fuss. They are solid and operate smoothly. I have the older version of those latches and after 25 years the handles started to come off. No such problem with these ones though, the top part where the handle attaches is a solid piece and won't break off. The older ones latch moved up as they moved out, these ones just move forward and backward and has to be lifted out. Not a gripe, just something to think about if you have two of these installed together.

title: Be cautious before using…
review: Be cautious before using ecoboilergrants.co.ukWhile they helped me get a free boiler replacement under the ECO4 scheme, the overall experience was poor. There were issues with communication, workmanship, and aftercare service.Key points to consider: * Read all reviews before using them. * Ensure contractors have relevant insurance and certifications (Gas Safe, etc.). * Get confirmation in writing that the system will be flushed before boiler installation.My experience: * Incomplete system flush: Despite requesting a system flush, it wasn't done before installing the new boiler as recommended. This led to warranty issues with the new boiler. * Poor workmanship: the finished soldered joints look amateurish and could fail over time, electrical cable placement concerns. * Unresponsive customer service: I faced difficulties getting responses to complaints via phone or email. * Multiple visits required to address issues: It took several visits for the installation company to partially address the cold spots in radiators. * Lack of documentation: I don't have paperwork to prove the system flush, potentially voiding the boiler warranty. The reason why I can say the above is because I paid £216 to Worcester Bosch (the boiler manufacturer) to inspect the installation. Had these people followed the recommended guidelines as per the Installation manual, I wouldn’t have had these issues. FREE DOES NOT MEAN BAD WORKMANSHIP.I recommend extreme caution when using ecoboilergrants.co.uk.

title: The good and the bad
review: The good, I ordered a Makita blower and accessories via the website and that I could collect next day from their Bristol outlet. The ordering process was quick and easy and the prices were very good (beating Amazon). The bad, when I got to the outlet I was told that I could have the accessories but all the blowers had been packed up and sent off back to their warehouse because the Bristol outlet was closing down and a new outlet was to be opened in Nailsea (where I had come from). A refund would be issued and I should reorder in a couple of days. Later, when I queried with CS as to when the Nailsea outlet was to be opened, the lady said she knew nothing of this and would get back to me. This hasn't happened but the refund has come through very quickly. The moral, always check with the store that the items are actually available to be collected. In the end I ordered the blower from Amazon with next day free delivery.

title: Advice if buying a new house
review: We bought in the Kinglass Meadows development in Bo’Ness and moved into our new home in Nov 2023. Sales process was fine and our initial 6 months in the house fine with snagging issues resolved quickly enough. We didn’t have major snagging issues (external company reviewed the house and commented on it being a good build). We are pleased with the standard of build. However, we are not pleased with the landscaping on the site (or the lack of landscaping) and despite asking MH Customer Service on numerous occasions in the last three months our questions/queries are literally ignored. At sales stage we were promised landscaping but we now know that what is “promised” at sales stage does not always materialise. We know MH are due off site soon and will hand over to the external maintenance team and we are concerned the landscaping will not be finished…..as promised  at sales stage. We also had issues with the access road to the site and after a few months of correspondence with MH East Scotland Director the residents concerns where finally listened to and positive action taken. Again, the sales team had made promises that were revoked. Therefore, my advice to new buyers on any MH site is to get in writing from MH what is promised at sales stage when you are listening to the sales “patter”. Follow up by email/letter with the sales team to clarify your understanding of what you are being told and get a reply back and file it away incase you need to refer back. There are many things coming to light that residents were told at sales stage that are either not materialising or being altered as the site development comes to an end. It’s exhausting (and feels like a full time job!) constantly messaging customers services to get no reply. We had leaking pipes in the garage a few weeks back that were sorted swiftly and in the same email I asked about landscaping for that query to be completely ignored. I will highlight again, build quality we are content with but we are disappointed with our external environment which is a shame as we feel let down with MH from what we were told at sales stage. If you are considering buying a MH then please do get everything in writing and I don’t mean the contract (which is quite MH focused) but the things that matter to you that help you decide if it’s the house/location/environment is for you and file it away so you can refer back when MH move the goal posts one you are moved in.

title: Customer service decline
review: We bought a Sherwood on the Long Grange Miller estate back in April. We didn’t have the best start when we were told we couldn’t reserve a plot without selling our other home first, although no one else seemed to have this issue. We eventually reserved online seeing as we weren’t allowed to on site. The recommended solicitors were terrible, we would never use them again.The on site viewings with Kevin were great, he was really helpful and told us everything we needed to know. Couldn’t fault him at all from start to finish. We since completed in April and eventually had a Customer Service 1 month meeting about 2 months in. We logged a few things then she was never to be seen or heard from again. Since then Customer Care was handed to site. We had a few issues like a leaking sink, toilet etc that took about 7 days to get resolved. However there is still issues ongoing and we are now starting to get fobbed off, although we are still yet to have most of our ‘Customer Care meetings’. Our en-suite stinks of stagnant water constantly. We were told to ‘empty the shower cup’ which isn’t a manufacturer standard nor a normal request to empty a cup weekly. From a plumbers inspection it appears the plumbing from the sink is connected to the shower and causing stagnant water. Still waiting for this to be resolved. Then onto our drive, which is starting to look like the back garden with the amount of grass growing through. A month or so later we are told they will resand it, which will cover the issue so it’s not their problem once the snagging period is over. The drive hasn’t been laid with a weed membrane and needs relaid to prevent the excess of weeds growing through. Site told us we should we resending our drive regularly. (Never came across this in my life). The customer care is severely lacking and seems like Miller Homes have stopped caring about this site and the purchasers since removing all Customer Care. Shame as our house is lovely, albeit with snags as you expect. But the latter part of the customer service with the misinformation has been terrible. We didn’t pay so much for a house with a drive that hasn’t been laid and a en-suite that stinks so bad it has 3 air fresheners. We feel really let down by Miller and didn’t have this experience with our other home which is also a new build by another developer.

title: Great house but a few issues.
review: Firstly we do love our Miller Home at Hawkhead, Paisley. We have, unfortunately had a few problems. The first being a gutter that badly leaked during heavy rain. It took 3 visits to fix the problem even when I told them what the problem was and it was eventually a very easy repair. The workmen for the first visit didn't even get out their van and submitted that the job was completed. We also had a burst pipe which completely flooded our downstairs. Miller claimed no responsibility as they said it should have been lagged but and independent plumber showed us the faulty valve that was fitted under our sink. This happened just before Christmas and our daughters wedding. We had to claim our insurance to get a new floor fitted downstairs, new kitchen cabinets and completely repainted. I bought everything all ready and it was ready at the end of June 2023.  I moved in and I was the only person living in my block for months, the outside was a complete building site and often difficult to get a car in - thankfully I don't drive but if I had visitors this was difficult.  It turns out this period of time was actually the best time in my property as when the other 10 or so families joined my little plot they turned out to be all renting through affordable housing.  I was not told this on purchasing the property and I was really hoping for a lovely community of buyers, a bit like my sister has in her new build.  Instead it's not uncommon for swearing, fighting, loud music, rubbish outside the houses and feral children running round the car park.  If you drive down Millfield Lane side a few times you'll see this too.I am writing this review after a recent car crash (literally) into the side of my house by one of the families which has thrown me over the edge.  I am now trying to get this fixed.  There is also a bin store outside which I can't even put my bin in as the neighbours have put a dead bird in, half their sunday dinner in without a bag etc - you just couldn't write it but just trying to paint the picture.The positives to my purchase are the staff were all very nice and helpful.  It was great to be able to pick my own carpet, kitchen tops etc and upgrade bits, it does really look great and I couldn't be happier with that side of things or how the house is built.  The snags were all dealt with quite quickly and there really wasn't many snags.I'd still recommend Miller Homes and really wish I'd have picked a different plot, so just writing this review to help others be a bit more wary about where they'll be on the map and perhaps not to rush buying things ready for the initial move date advertised...

This to me again sounds crazy, who is going to put that down at this stage? Finally when asked what they can do on the deposit, part exchange, help move they said nothing, even though Right move on the exact property advertises these services for this plot (false advertising or click bait anyone?) Hopefully things can only get better in the future and if we do look to buy with Miller i hope its a-lot smoother than it has been so far…lets see. It shouldn't be difficult, it shouldn't be a hoop jumping process, it should be smooth, enjoyable and exciting. This is our next chapter and so far feels very frustrating.

title: Could have been 5 stars …
review: With just a little more effort, this could so easily be a 5 star review. My order was dispatched quickly, sent to DPD and I was alerted to delivery the following day. On delivery day DPD, updated that there was a delay. As I wasn’t about the following day, I opted for delivery at my local Homebase. DPD stated delivery would take place 2 days after the original delivery date. On delivery day 2, I checked at lunchtime, to see if my parcel had arrived at Homebase, to find the package was being taken back to DVS power tools. So far none of this detracts from DVS… but…. I spoke to Gareth at DVS customer service, who said he would contact DPD to see if he could get the package taken to Homebase, and would contact me once he had spoken to DPD. No contact all afternoon from Gareth, I telephoned, no answer, left a message, no response, telephoned as gain at just before 5pm another message left, no response. I emailed asking for an update. Today DPD delivered my package to my home address, not Homebase. I had no notification from Gareth or DPD, no response from Gareth to my phone messages, his promise to update me or to my email. I emailed Gareth to update him that I had my parcel. In response to that I received a blunt email, telling me he would update me if he hears from DPD, followed by another saying he was glad my parcel arrived and he doesn’t know why communication was missed… something not quite right there. So in summary, product great, initially good service, spoilt by poor customer service when the delivery went wrong, ignored despite efforts to contact, finished off by 2 contradictory emails! Shame really, could have been great.

title: Defective replacement

The threading on the holders are such that it does not fasten to the filter well and results in dripping non-filtered water into the pitcher and therefore causing a higher TDS reading. This will eventually cause one to believe that the filter will need replacing sooner than necessary. I have tested the fastening of new filters on all three holders, and determined that the threading is too thick on the ones that were purchased post-2022, which causes difficulties in screwing on the filter and results in a gap between the filter and the holder. I have photos of the issues if you require a visual aid in my description. For now, I will put up with the cracks in the pitcher and use the original (purchased 2020) filter holder with replaced filters to enjoy ZeroWater filtered water. I will be sending back the recently purchased system.

All About Denby 
When you buy Denby, you're choosing items with purpose and soul: hand-crafted, considered and made-to-last pieces that are truly a conscious choice. We’re still on the same site in Derbyshire where the pottery was founded in 1809 and our rich heritage is built on the generations of craftspeople making pottery here. Nestled next door to the seam of clay which our founder discovered, many traditional hand-crafting techniques are still used in our factory today. Everything we design and craft has versatility, beauty and durability, and is truly styled by life.
Versatile 
One set can be everyday and special occasions, and every piece can be used in the oven, freezer, microwave and dishwasher. Our ranges are super versatile and multi-functional so a smaller number of pieces are needed - cook, serve and store in the same piece.  Mugs double as plant pots, bowls as candle or trinket holders and jugs as vases.
Beautiful 
Our stunning glazes and shapes make Denby a lovely thing to have in your home, share when you’re entertaining and also to buy as a thoughtful and sustainable gift. Our ceramics and homewares are not just for the kitchen - enjoy them around the home to add style as well as function to any room.
Durable 
Denby’s durability is legendary, an attribute which becomes increasingly important as we look to reduce our disposable purchases. Our stoneware ranges come with a 10 year guarantee, and as our stoneware is super-strong, you can use it confidently and for occasions when you might otherwise use a disposable plate or cup.

review: We ordered from the Denby website & added some pieces to our main collection soon after. Easy to navigate website. Ordering was easy. Items arrived securely packaged & delivery was very prompt. We are delighted with the product itself & is excellant quality.

title: Not the Denby standard I expected
review: I ordered what I thought were 4 x Denby white plates and a blue cereal bowl plus 2 x white cups. The order took more than a week to arrive. When it arrived, the plates were cream, and the bowl was tiny (rice). The first interactions with 'customer service' were poor; it was only when I asked to be moved on to a manager that the person started acting like customer 'service'. After much palaver, they decided to accept a return and arranged for DPD to pick up. DPD lied about arriving at the right time to pick up items, and it was only when I challenged the driver about being truthful the next day (when he turned up to deliver something else) that he admitted that he had lied about the previous day's pick-up. He arrived 3.5 hours before he was meant to! Denby was good about rearranging the collection at this point - this was a helpful person at Denby called Gemma. However, the first customer service person I dealt with refused to send out replacement items so that they would cross in the shipment.  I ended up using the Philip & Morris website to order the plates & bowl I wanted. They were cheaper than the same plates on the Denby website, and the shipment arrived the very next day! So, I got a better service for Denby products from a third party. Overall, an unnecessary palaver made worse by a company that is supposed to be world-class. I am still waiting for my refund. Some of your 'customer service' people need retraining! The website needs to be updated so that it is clear to see whether a plate is white or cream and clarity is given about bowl sizes. In the basket and order confirmation, the plates looked white. Do better, Denby! I have been buying your products for years, but if this had been a first interaction, I would never have bought from you again. The motto of the story - use third-party dealers who represent Denby better than Denby!

Everything we design and craft has versatility, beauty and durability, and is truly styled by life.
Versatile 
One set can be everyday and special occasions, and every piece can be used in the oven, freezer, microwave and dishwasher. Our ranges are super versatile and multi-functional so a smaller number of pieces are needed - cook, serve and store in the same piece.  Mugs double as plant pots, bowls as candle or trinket holders and jugs as vases.
Beautiful 
Our stunning glazes and shapes make Denby a lovely thing to have in your home, share when you’re entertaining and also to buy as a thoughtful and sustainable gift. Our ceramics and homewares are not just for the kitchen - enjoy them around the home to add style as well as function to any room.
Durable 
Denby’s durability is legendary, an attribute which becomes increasingly important as we look to reduce our disposable purchases. Our stoneware ranges come with a 10 year guarantee, and as our stoneware is super-strong, you can use it confidently and for occasions when you might otherwise use a disposable plate or cup.
title: I made a mistake when I placed my order
review: I made a mistake when I placed my order, accidentally order Azure when I needed Azure Haze. I realized this shortly after submitting my order (same day), but discovered there was no way to cancel or change my order. Considering there was no way my order could have been processed yet (placed Friday evening), this seems like terrible customer service.

title: Your website was beautiful and easy to…
review: Your website was beautiful and easy to navigate.  Ordering went well.  You established a delivery date of several days ago.  Everyday FedEx says its coming tomorrow.  When I tracked it; it said "customer refused delivery or was closed" for today's delivery.  This wasn't true.  I was never contacted. Now it's supposedly coming tomorrow.  There are two boxes.  Sometimes it says one is coming sometimes it says both are being delivered.  Stay tuned for when I actually receive my dinnerware.  This is my third denby pattern in 60 years.  Can't wait to see it.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Elegant Paint Colors!
review: I received a packet of very useful information and color chips that I requested.  The packet is very comprehensive and all of the colors are so beautiful that it's hard to make a decision on just one or two!  I can tell just from the information I read that this is top notch paint!!

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Sample colour pot duo
review: Ordered two colours of sample pots from The Sweet Treats range for last minute painting of my dining room before Christmas. Pots arrived very timely and complete with small paint brush for ease of application. Fabulous colours and great paint opacity. Dining room looks splendid in Mochi .. warm, cosy and classy looking colour.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Best floor paint ever
review: Best floor paint ever, have been painting wooden floorboards for thirty years using every brand on the market ,intelligent floor paint easy the best and unlike some others ACTUALLY DOES WHAT IT SAYS ON THE TIN .

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Love the paint
review: Love the paint; it’s a complete dream to use and I have it in quite a few rooms in my house. The Little Greene website is easy to use and helpful with deciding complementary colours. Whenever I’ve had a query, it’s been answered promptly and customer services are super helpful. They offer a speedy delivery service and my paint has always been well packaged. Their paint is one of my go-to brands.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Big thumbs up for Re:Mix
review: Used Re:mix for reasons of budget and environmental concerns. First time using LG and am delighted. Great coverage and fabulous colour (light Beauvais)

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Really fast delivery and well packaged
review: Really fast delivery and well packaged. Ordered a few days before Christmas, expecting delivery in the new year only to receive it on Christmas Eve.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Superb product and service…
review: I ordered paint just before Christmas and it arrived very quickly. I've now painted a room top to toe colour drenching with the new intelligent paint. The coverage is remarkable. Excellent all round.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Great customer care
review: One tin of paint arrived damaged. I called the company and within 24 hours a replacement tin had been delivered. Impressive (and friendly) customer service

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Excellent Company.
review: Excellent quality and colour shades in the Intelligent Emulsion and Intelligent Eggshell. Fast delivery Very well packed. The best interior paint I`ve ever used.  Accurate colours card.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: This is one of the best paints we've…
review: This is one of the best paints we've ever used.  The coverage and depth of colour is brilliant,  this is our 5th different colour choice and we are not disappointed with any of them.  We highly recommend this paint.  .Basically it does what it says on the tin

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Prompt response
review: I have received the free sample colour cards and wallpaper booklet. So far, I'm very impressed! Fabulous choice of colours and wallpapers. Sent promptly, very well organised and the information is clear.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: A really great site once learned
review: A really great site once learned. Takes bit of learning how to use it. I chose from the charts and wished I’d looked up and checked those colours on the site afterwards. Partly because of that I made a mistake with one wall colour which had to be repainted. Could you advise to check the paper chart colours on screen perhaps?

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Theatre Red Absolute Matt
review: This would have been 5 stars if the colour was as advertised on the website.It's much more lighter and blue based than the image shows, even after 3 coats on primed walls.It applies cerise pink but dries to a deeper strawberry red.I expected more of a cherry red / burgundy shade.It applied beautifully and is very pigmented with a smooth velvety finish.Far better than most other high end brands in my opinion.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Lovely paint
review: Lovely paint, good coverage & nice finish. Only reason for 4 stars is that delivery is a bit longer than I anticipated and I think if you purchase sample pots it would be nice to have a free sample card.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Love the colour but coverage wasn't…
review: Love the colour but coverage wasn't quite what it said on the tin, and walls need a second coat. I guess we should have used the primer paint but had primed the walls already with white emulsion, and thought that a single coat would be enough, for paint at this price. Low fumes and easy to clean brushes.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Fantastic paint colours and charts
review: Fantastic paint colours and charts  Difficult to navigate the website hence 4 stars

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Wallpaper and paint samples
review: I requested 3 wallpaper samples and a paint chart. I love how everything was free which is helpful. Little Greene promptly sent me all their paint charts but unfortunately I cannot give them 5 stars because 2 of my paper sample choices are out of stock and I am still waiting for them to arrive. Hopefully they will arrive at some point so I can make an informed choice.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Great paint, patchy delivery
review: Great paint colours that you can’t find elsewhere. Coverage not as good as some more mainstream brands. Eg 4 coats may be needed rather than 3. Patchy fulfilment & delivery at times. One bonus is lack of 25 emails for one order as with many other companies!

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Great choice of colours with excellent…
review: Great choice of colours with excellent depth of colour and and great wallpapers, excellent service, fast delivery, well wrapped.    I’m not convinced about the  “intelligent” paint though - still needed two coats at least.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Beautiful paint in too-small sample pots
review: This review is for my recent sample pot purchase. I appreciate how quickly LG post our their pots and the inclusion of a wee brush is appreciated.  I also received a Brew Tea Co tea bag as well, which is a nice touch. As ever LG demonstrates its quality for paint itself. I ordered the recent samples along with a few from other paint brands. I take off one star due to the size of the pots.  Other companies provide significantly bigger sample pots, usually double, for a similar price, even Paint and Paper library.  The small LG pots just don't go far enough.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: My last batch of paint arrived with…
review: My last batch of paint arrived with extremelyDented tins. The boxes and Packaging are perfect so by deduction the packaging or mixing process is flawed. The Lao T itself is

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: My experience …
review: I love the paints although the colour on the wall differs from the paint you see in the pot. The green is perfect but I need a different colour for the rest of the walls. I will look again and make another choice.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Delivery Poor, Customer Service Excellent
review: I recently placed my first order with Little Greene and paid for expedited delivery. Unfortunately, despite the confirmed delivery date from UPS, the paint was repeatedly delayed, with conflicting updates. This caused significant inconvenience, as our painter was left on standby, and we were waiting around unnecessarily.To Little Greene’s credit, customer service was responsive - I emailed about the issue on a Wednesday evening and I had a constructive response within an hour. They were straight on to UPS and offered to send a replacement via a different courier if the paint didn’t arrive. Thankfully, the paint has now been delivered, but the experience was more painful than it should have been.I will definitely buy from Little Greene again because of the excellent customer service, and hopefully by then they will have ditched UPS!

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Website change please!!
review: I’m 100% sure of the quality of all LG paints and finishes.  I also love the little wooden paintbrush which comes with a single sample pot.  Nice touch! My reduction to 4 stars is down to your website - it’s difficult to navigate and I just want to see all your shades across the colour chart - not separated into “neutrals/warm colours” etc.  Perhaps keep those sections, but also provide a page which just shows each colour from the brightest white to the darkest black. Thank you!

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: I like the paint colours but make the colours choosing card in a more flexible system
review: I like the paint colours. I like being able to lift the colour paint colours on the colour Swatch. However I found it tricky to physically put together the swatch colours I was trying to match so I ended up having to pluck them off the card to sit then side by side. So I'd recommend having the cardboard swatches available as bigger oblongs and in loose in a pack. The tester paint pots are quite expensive so it's good to have free ways of getting a closer print match using the colour cards first. I find using a phone to look at colours never gives the real colours. Hence my suggestions.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Feature wall project
review: Feature wall projectWe ordered a litre of yellow pink to paint a feature wall in our lounge. We woefully underestimated how much paint we needed based on guidance on website - so have ordered more. Free delivery is a huge bonus. We love the colour choice and finish of the intelligent Matt and it was true to the colour chart online.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Would buy again
review: The good: Colour is as imagined and I love it. Also It washes off hands very easily. No toxic smell.The bad: Needed 3 coats. Also paint pot showed a completely different shade so I was really worried about opening it, querying it or returning it.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Lovely samples and good arrival time
review: Lovely samples and good arrival time. Only disappointment was that not all of the samples arrived, and they could have been slightly larger which would have helped in making a choice as in some the pattern showing was very limited.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Lovely quality paint
review: My samples were sent out really quickly and the brush that came with them was a nice touch. I always love little greene paint as it’s such good quality, the coverage is fantastic. Only downside is the price, it is expensive.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Efficient service
review: Efficient service, excellent packaging, thoughtful teabag and wooden paint brush included. Price a little on the hefty side but paint is quality.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Good range of colours, but.
review: Good range of colours, like the products. But Customer Service open hours are not good, and have had issues with delivery times. Still waiting for sample ordered on 18th October, it is now 3 November.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: The paint is lovely but I think it is…
review: The paint is lovely but I think it is appalling that you don't offer a return policy on unopened, sealed, tins.  I purchased a 5L yellow which I knew was the wrong shade as soon as I got home.  I returned to the shop but had no option but to purchase another, very expensive 5L.   What is the problem with having unopened, sealed stock in your shop to re-sell? I wont be buying from again, for this reason.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Colours are limited and don’t look like…
review: Colours are limited and don’t look like the expensive sample book purchased. Expensive glass sample jars with very little paint, barely enough to paint a swatch.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Nice paint far to expensive for what it…
review: Nice paint far to expensive for what it is

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Beware: they do not accept returns
review: Very happy with the quality of the paint and the colour of my walls, but beware: they do not accept returns, even if the paint is unopened. I currently have a tin of paint that cost me £68 and I do not need it. If they had a better returns policy I would rate higher, but this has left me disappointed in the company. I would recommend NOT buying direct from Little Greene, instead use an independent business that will accept returns.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Was rather cross that a tin of paint I…
review: Was rather cross that a tin of paint I nearly ordered in the morning had increased in price by £4 by the afternoon. Also had 2 sets of colour charts sent!

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Great colour, disappointing coverage
review: The colour is glorious, dries quickly, no nasty chemical smells. However I was disappointed with the coverage - having meticulously prepped the surface I had hoped that 2 coats would suffice, 3 at the absolute most, but I had to do 4 coats of paint, and even then it is still slightly patchy in places. I had hoped to have some paint left over to use in other areas of the house, however I don't, which is a real shame given the price. The colous is amazing though!

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Expensive samples
review: We haven't started painting yet because we have been choosing colours, we've bought 9 sample pots (£59 including postage). The pots are beautifully packed, the paintbrush inside the box is very useful and the teabag is a nice idea for those who like tea. The paint covers well and two coats give a nice finish. We've made our choice and were about to pay £260 when I saw the promo box. Some companies discount the sample if you buy the product so I rang but there are no discounts or promotions.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Delivery has been stressful
review: Delivery has been stressful. Needed to change options to leave in safe place as are we’re away on holiday. Could not reach you by telephone or live chat even though before 5pm. No reply to email until next day. Impossible to change via UPS website. It’s taken hours and even now we have a problem because it’s been despatched in 2 batches but only one has been delivered and our decorator is waiting. Such a shame  because the paint is always lovely,

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Website isn’t working properly so I…
review: Website isn’t working properly so I rang regarding the issue  and had a quite rude man saying he didn’t setup the website so couldn’t help.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Great product but the samples were so different to the pictures.
review: Delivery was super quick and Free P&P. Samples are well presented and the little teabag is sweet. Paint has great coverage and easily applied.  Paint brush is a fab touch. My main issue was the ACTUAL sample colour was completely different to the representative picture. Order 3 and all 3 were SO different.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Superb product...can't say the same about the delivery service.
review: As always, the product is top quality. Hence three stars, rather than one. The service sadly not up to standard. I paid for express delivery, but had to call Little Green, as my paint hadn't arrived. Lady I spoke to was super helpful and sorted the problem. The tracking information didn't update to tell me my paint was out for delivery. I needed the express delivery system to work properly, so my decorator (who has more work than time available) was not messed around.System needs checking and reviewing as your major rival, even on standard delivery, seems to get stuff to me within 36 hours.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Ordered a tester pot for £5.50
review: Ordered a tester pot for £5.50, which is nearly double that of Dulux. It arrived in huge, expensive packaging that went straight in the recycling. And a paintbrush - nice touch but I'd have preferred a cheaper tester, given that I will have to buy a few to find the right colour.

description: Little Greene is an independent, British paint manufacturer, committed to the socially and environmentally responsible production of high quality paints and wallpapers.
title: Colour is exactly what we wanted
review: Colour is exactly what we wanted; primer applies beautifully. Top coat paint (floor paint) quite "sticky" to apply but works pretty well.The reason for giving three stars is that despite being careful to apply in temperature above 8 degrees, and leaving the floor for more than 7 days to cure before walking on it in slippers only and being careful not to drag anything across the floor, it has scratched in places with primer showing through. Disappointing.

title: Boiler (oil) warranty flawed
review: Boiler (oil) has been in for a few months and to be fair it appears to be working ok from a customer point of view. My disappointment is with both the installer and Navien. First, I emailed the installer before he started with clear request about pipe runs to keep them direct but the hot water was sent round a longer route, a real puzzle to me so after he had 'finished' I  routed the dhw pipe correctly so now we have hot water at the tap much sooner so saving water and energy. Worse he failed to do the commissioning report and then when asked ignored my enquiries. In meantime Navien issued a warranty certificate stating it was invalid if no commissioning report was present with the boiler. Having had no success with the installer who eventually stated it was all a fuss about nothing and he had been too busy to reply to my enquiries, I approached Navien for a solution. No further progress to date so I have a warranty that states unless I have a report that to date neither the installer or supplier have been able or willing to provide, is not valid.  To sum it up, a disappointing experience leaving me thinking I might be better off without the so called warranty that should give peace of mind for the customer but without the report does the opposite. Those who give the package five stars obviously were fortunate to engage an installer who was conscientious, hard working, listened to the customers requirements, did not cut corners for their own convenience and were respectful. What is also sad is that Navien can issue a warranty certificate without the supporting data recording the boiler has been correctly installed and verified safe to use. The solution would have been so easy. To the installer I say why not just honestly record the installation as you go rather than selling the customer short. To Navien, do not issue a warranty certificate until you have seen the commissioning report. Is that so difficult? Is it that the industry thinks oil presents fewer risks than gas so the niceties of proper compliance and safety assurance can be taken less seriously? Perhaps a question for the regulator to consider?9/02/2024. Finally received the commissioning report that the installer should have completed but actually completed by an engineer sent and presumably paid by Navien. It highlighted incorrect primary pipe sizing, ie undersized, incorrect and unsafe siting indoors of the fire safety valve and unsafe drain from tiger loop bowl. It is plain to see why the installer, Sigma, refused to complete the report as it would have meant admitting to gross negligence. I will definitely report this to the regulators as there may be other installations with similar defects. Customer support weak as I have had to chase all the way to get this far. I now await the first year boiler service to see if our new boiler is condemned and the warrantee kicks in. I would welcome a constructive comment from Navien but not holding my breath on that one.09/02/24. Navien have replied asking for more detail. I don't think there is more to add, just read the above. Any further detail they think they need they have my contact details on the report by Jim T. and I am happy to fill in anything more.

title: Navien Boiler
review: I regret not realizing how unreliable Navien Boilers are and how poor their customer service can be. My boiler is less than a year old but has frequently shut off, and now it's displaying a loss of flame fault (0012).Since it's still under warranty, my emergency insurance won’t cover it, but Navien insists that a service is required before the one-year mark. I've made it clear that the boiler is faulty, plain and simple.Currently, I have no heating or hot water, and they can’t provide a timeline for when an engineer will arrive. The worst bit is that they feel I can do nothing about it.If only I could turn back time and choose a Worcester or another brand instead. I strongly advise avoiding Navien at all costs.

title: Buy-a-parcel/Makita is great to deal with
review: The service from buy-a-parcel was very good, The price, with eBay's 20%code, for a brand new warranted Makita 18v SDS+ hammer drill, was very competitive, & particularly so with the  buy-a-parcel bundle: including 17 SDS bits- both short & long!!...in a really handy tool roll that sealed nicely & even had a full -length spare zipped internal pocket, along with a small 'quick -release' - sds-adapter & 'normal' drill chuck... giving the capability to use as a non- hammer, using ordinary drill bits. You know how these things, like some toolboxes,  can be so cheaply made that they are barely fit for the use , &/or can even damage the tool-cordWell this bundle all works really well [ although I haven't had an opportunity to actually try it out in practice] & I was gutted to have to return ;  it as even though the Makita 18v SDS+ 242Z drill wasn't too heavy, at 2.6-2.7kg 'bare'; (depending on my not particularly accurate scale ⚖️); in fact it is a beautifully balanced tool for a cordless SDS hammer drill 😁...but with a battery & chisel bit attached:- & 3.25kg with the smallest spade chisel -(& also in the tool roll supplied!) it was still going to be too much,  for me to work on a ladder, with mostly one hand ~ in chiseling cracked mortar from the side of a house-- & particularly as id likely need to be frequently using the medium sized chisel - bringing up the complete tool weight to 3.55kg/7.8lbs-- and I can't see myself individually:  being able to manage it easily enough,  to do the job: without causing unnecessary damage! Nb - the weights specified are with "for makita" batteries by E-plus....the makstar 5ah battery adds 0.05kg, or 0.2lbs to the weight ---- so a Makita 3.0ah battery might be marginally less weight, but not quite enough for me- & id have to buy smaller batteries, which goes against the grain' as I've even upgraded my 5ah's to 6ahI'm fairly strong, but at 63 & with some injuries, but still working -i've had to be particularly careful with the weight of the tools that I purchase.Maybe 🤔 a brute' of a younger builder might be able to manage it ? My experience with other power tools,  and having finally upgraded to Makita's 18v battery platform a bit late in life! ~ I do note, that whilst Makita's 18v range of tools that I've experienced ~ whilst not necessarily being the most powerful available;- but have all been really well balanced in the hand & 'feel reliable' & of reasonably robust construction-eg the grinder is over a foot long, & heavy-ish, but is a pleasure to use, with the battery used as a secondary 'handle/body-push'My wish would have been for Makita to have included a chisel function on their smaller brushless range of SDS+ hammer drills ~ particularly the '183' which is the uprated '171Z' (lovely light easy to use SDS+ hammer drill without chisel -function) but with considerably more power & an led light & I believe variable speed dial---- it must have been a decision that Makita made for other, reasons not to include the chisel function on their more manageable SDS+ cordless 18v drills as that '183' with a chisel function would perhaps be ½kilo lighter , and albeit not for heavier jobs --would have been perfect for me.As it is I'm having to go 'off- brand' : Listen up Makita! & source a Ryobi SDS+ which at 2.1kg makes it the ½kilo minimum lighter- that might work for me---- however this is not my preferred option as I've heard of several reliability issues for their particular design of the smaller SDS+ drill... but I don't have much choice as a job to do 🤷🏼Hope this much review helps 🍀 somebody -- In summation, the 242' SDS+ 18v Makita hammer drill is beautifully balanced & relatively lightweight tool!-- although I haven't tried using it!& it's hard to beat "buy-a-parcel's" offering with the tool roll of 17 large & small SDS+ bits and SDS +adapter&quick release drill -chuck-- I think 🤔 I paid approx £178 with eBay's 20% offer with free delivery & the ability to register for makita's 3 year's warranty-- that's still the better part of two hundred quid for a bare tool..IE no batteries or charger or box, but if one is in the market for a reliable branded cordless tool, from a respectable retailer, then imo,  one would be lucky to get a substantially better deal From my own research -- if doing heavy work - I'd get the biggest drill available, so didn't run into problems and/or to substantiate the warranty -ie the '003, or 004' if thinking Makita, though there are several competitors & many useful YouTubers previewing them. 😉💤!God bless 🙏🏽

Our mission 
Is to continue to drive cordless innovation through sustainable development. The environment is everyone's concern, and we are no exception. Our commitment is expressed through our cordless programs such as the 18V ONE+™ and the 36V MAX POWER battery systems, which reduce the number of unnecessary batteries and chargers required for each tool (Ryobi® batteries interchange between tools), have significantly less noise and zero harmful emissions especially versus petrol powered equivalents. Beyond strict compliance with current anti-pollution standards in the design of its products, the RYOBI® brand plays a part in respect of the environment by meeting European safety standards, considered as being amongst the strictest in the world, including the WEEE and RoHS directives.

Ryobi® is one of the largest and most innovative power tool manufacturers in the world. Dedicated to delivering outstanding performance and reliability within the DIY market, we’ve built an enviable reputation by developing a real knowledge of exactly what people need from their power tools so that they can work more precisely, efficiently and safely. Through developing such a diverse range of tools, we’ve become a complete solutions provider for the home and garden - there’s a Ryobi® for every task and everyone!
Currently you can view Ryobi® tools with leading partners such as Amazon, Argos, B&Q, CBS Power Tools, Halfords and Very.co.uk as well as directly through the RyobiTools.co.uk website. 

Our mission 
Is to continue to drive cordless innovation through sustainable development. The environment is everyone's concern, and we are no exception. Our commitment is expressed through our cordless programs such as the 18V ONE+™ and the 36V MAX POWER battery systems, which reduce the number of unnecessary batteries and chargers required for each tool (Ryobi® batteries interchange between tools), have significantly less noise and zero harmful emissions especially versus petrol powered equivalents. Beyond strict compliance with current anti-pollution standards in the design of its products, the RYOBI® brand plays a part in respect of the environment by meeting European safety standards, considered as being amongst the strictest in the world, including the WEEE and RoHS directives.
title: Good kit ,  no bits,
review: The kit arrived well packaged, and included the '"free tool " I had chosen, ( probably a good way of getting rid of old stock,) but still value for money, let's hope it lasts as long as my old Bosch drill/ driver,  would have been nice to have included some screw driver bits, or drill bits as well. The torch as good light, but feels a little flimsy for workshop use, we shall see ! Lol

title: Feedback as requested
review: I've bought a fair number of Ryobi tools and batteries now and thy have been mostly good. None have failed - though the old Nicad batteries were rubbish....and my circular saw has never been as good after a tumble - just will not cut straight anymore despite my attempts to straighten it.I am a bit concerned that tools get sent out in brightly coloured Ryobi boxes then left on the door step. The delivery is not that fast - usually a few days - these are not cheap items - why not 'next day'?  My last pair of 5Ah batteries are fine but they were loose inside a box and some of the plastic packaging was damaged - a bit of internal packing material would be a good idea.

title: Poor customer service
review: My order arrived when I was out. Fine in itself but not the way it was packaged.This was a Christmas gift for my husband. Package one whilst in a brown external box, had a sticker attached that clearly stated "chainsaw" and was very visible.Packaged two didn't even have any packaging and was just the product box. Bright green with the image of its contents. I'm all for sustainability but to see what's being delivered is not good. Package two's box was damaged.I called Ryobi on the 18th December, the day after delivery. Apparently it's not their issue re damage, but the courier. They'd have to get back to me and arrange collection and resolution. Today is the 30th December. I've had no correspondence whatsoever. Yes it's been Christmas but there has been ample time on the days after 18th to deal with this.  Not even a holding email or acknowledgement.You spoiled my surprise for hubby this Christmas and I'm still awaiting a response. Poor form for a company with what I believed to be a good name.Far from impressed with your customer service (or rather,  lack of it!)

I didn't receive a delivery slip on 29th which I thought was odd as I always do from past deliveries, but assumed it must have been delivered as I was told it would be. Fast forward to 4th December, I finally received a delivery slip confirming delivery had been made on 4th, I had no prior communication to explain the delivery was late, or it hadn't been made when it should have been. I get it that sometimes things happen that mean a delivery can't take place at an expected time but this needs to be communicated to a customer as soon as the company is aware.

Founded in 1954 by Colin and Walter Berry as a joinery manufacturer, C&W Berry is recognised as the North West's leading supplier of building materials. Situated in Leyland on Golden Hill Lane, our main 40-acre sales site accommodates for trade, house builders and DIY markets and is easily accessible to customers from all over Lancashire. We operate our own delivery fleet of different sized vehicles that are capable of efficiently distributing large or small orders to building sites and homes throughout the region.
Our broad product range includes over 45,000 products from construction grade timber, bricks and blocks, electrical supplies, plumbing and heating products, internal and external doors, power tools, and practically anything needed to complete a construction project.
We have also recently opened a brand new bathroom showroom adjacent to our main sales site on Braconash Road that features a huge variety of products from popular brands including Infinita, Burlington, Laufen and Crosswater. title: Scammers

There's a pretty big incentive for keeping people on higher tarrifs because the more money people pay per kwh, the more money metro get in fees! Daylight robbery!!!I know this review won't do anything but people need to get together and make a fuss to their local MP to push for companies like this to be harshly regulated (metro isn't regulated). Don't get me wrong, I beleive sub meters are a fantastic idea but run by disgraceful people.It means landlords don't have to spend a fortune to provide every tenant with their own electricity supply which would result in that cost being passed on to the tenants in rent.Please contact your local MP and make them aware of this issue!! Very early days yet as I have only just taken delivery, but radio reception appears to be good and sound quality for both radio and CD player is very good.

description: With over 25 years of expertise, We're Advancing Audio Technology one beautifully designed product at a time.

review: Excellent kit for the price!   Slightly complicated to set various things as these devices always are!  Why can’t they make it simpler? But works well, sound quality very good for price point but not best.  3 year warranty a bonus!   Well done.

description: With over 25 years of expertise, We're Advancing Audio Technology one beautifully designed product at a time.

review: Delivery of item was great.  The radio looks good.A couple of niggles though, when playing it sounds good (bought specifically for Boom radio station) but moving in different positions or room to room, “static” interference is annoying even with aerial extended. The aerial extends horizontally & can’t be rotated vertically, so positioning it is a little awkward, so that the aerial isn’t jutting out towards objects/people.  If anyone can suggest a remedy(ies) that would be helpful.For the price it is a reasonable radio.

description: With over 25 years of expertise, We're Advancing Audio Technology one beautifully designed product at a time.

review: Xmas present opened today and very much appreciated. Easy to tune into our favourite radio stations and works reasonably well with DAB+, wish our signal was stronger. FM perfect reception. So much for technological development.

description: With over 25 years of expertise, We're Advancing Audio Technology one beautifully designed product at a time.

review: My order was delivered on time and very securely packaged. Took me a little while to sort out the presets but straight forward once I got used to the process. So far, very pleased with sound from such a compact radio.

review: Great radio ... fabulous sound quality, easy to operate.  Only didn't give it a 5 star rating as the digital info panel scrolls soooo slowly, I like to see the song artist & title (if I don't know who it is) and it seems to take forever to scroll across the screen.

description: With over 25 years of expertise, We're Advancing Audio Technology one beautifully designed product at a time.

review: Just received. Very easy to set up and sounds good. At the price it seems very good value for money.

description: With over 25 years of expertise, We're Advancing Audio Technology one beautifully designed product at a time.
title: Small radio
review: Received my small radio today and I am really pleased. It looks nice and is well made and the sound is nice for its size. I needed something that what small and compact for my work area and this radio is ideal

description: With over 25 years of expertise, We're Advancing Audio Technology one beautifully designed product at a time.
title: Looks good and sounds good once I had…
review: Looks good and sounds good once I had mastered the setting up instructions.  The alarm a little complicated to work out

description: With over 25 years of expertise, We're Advancing Audio Technology one beautifully designed product at a time.
title: Delivery vs performance
review: I was pleased that the device was delivered ahead of scheduled date. However, I was not in so the package was left on the front doorstep in full public view. It was not wrapped in any way, so it was obvious what it was as the box depicted its contents. It could so easily have been swiped. Additionally, as it wasn't wrapped and it was raining that didn't do the box any favours.That having been said, the device works admirably. My daughter has one which she talked favourably of, and this was the inspiration for me getting one. I hope it gives years of trouble free use.

description: With over 25 years of expertise, We're Advancing Audio Technology one beautifully designed product at a time.
title: Problematic!
review: Instructions vague - Bluetooth instructions not as stated. USB port very slow to charge - also won't charge samsung a32 5g but will samsung a22 5g?! Rest of functions not the easiest to get your head round. Sound good. Big display.

description: With over 25 years of expertise, We're Advancing Audio Technology one beautifully designed product at a time.
title: A well made radio for the money
review: The radio seems very well made.  However; it was quite confusing, as our area seems unable to receive DAB stations & we were trying to tune it in on the DAB settings.  After 3 hours trying!  we eventually thought to try tuning on FM & after trying this, we finally managed to tune in the pre-set stations, apart from this, it is very good for the money.  Also, there is a very small white key type thing! which we have no idea what its meant to be used for.  The clock feature only stays on if the radio is plugged into the mains on standby, otherwise, if using the battery, there is no clock showing, which is a bit annoying!  A good radio though, probably even better if the area you live in receives DAB stations.

description: With over 25 years of expertise, We're Advancing Audio Technology one beautifully designed product at a time.
title: Product looks and sounds good but…
review: Product looks and sounds good but working out how to preset stations was a frustrating nightmare even with careful study of the instruction booklet. Changing stations requires pressing quite a few buttons. If you are impatient like me this is annoying. The radio needs to be positioned at eye level to be able to see the screen easily to be able to change stations.

description: With over 25 years of expertise, We're Advancing Audio Technology one beautifully designed product at a time.
title: Ergonomics Could Be Better
review: Pre-sales questions to Azatom were answered promptly. Not the friendliest radio to set up or use, it appears one has to scroll through up to forty presets to get the one required. Why not have ten buttons for the user's most used radio stations, thus giving a one button press for each channel.  Tuning is done using an up/down pair of buttons; it would have been nice if tuning could have been done via rotary dial (possibly a dual function with the volume control). Time will tell if I return to my Pure DAB as my radio of choice. Sound quality is good, maximum volume should be louder.

description: With over 25 years of expertise, We're Advancing Audio Technology one beautifully designed product at a time.
title: Should be 4star but...
review: This should be 4star but we had to return one radio because something was broken inside. Customer support was excellent with a replacement sent immmediately. I have now set it all up and its working well. Setup is a bit fiddly until you get the hang of it.Sound is good.

description: With over 25 years of expertise, We're Advancing Audio Technology one beautifully designed product at a time.
title: Everything was good except the volume
review: Everything was good except the volume. On maximum, I can only hear it if I’m near to the radio. It needs more volume.

description: With over 25 years of expertise, We're Advancing Audio Technology one beautifully designed product at a time.
title: Interface is shocking. Sound is good.
review: Interface is shocking. Remote control is easy for some things, main controls for others. Lots of buttons but confusing. It's like they are tech focused rather than consumer focused. And I am super techie who's written countless user interfaces over the decades.Cannot insert or eject a cd if not in cd mode.To be fair, when I registered the product I has to type the serial number in uppercase as their boffins don't appear to know how to write user interfaces or use ucase.Really disappointed in the design and usability. Sound however is really good.So if you can ignore the clumsy interface, it sounds good.One thing that did concern me was that the off button doesn't work when I'min a hurry. I have to cycle through dab, cd, USB etc to get the off button to work.

description: With over 25 years of expertise, We're Advancing Audio Technology one beautifully designed product at a time.
title: Does what it should do but feels cheap.
review: I bought an AZATOM A2 DAB/DAB+ Portable Digital Radio direct from the company via Amazon. I chose it because of the claimed long battery life.  It arrived promptly and was easy to set up. The radio appears to do what it is supposed to do. However the quality of materials is not what we have come to expect from daily experience with our smartphones. The plastic case feels cheap and the buttons operate with tacky plastic clicks rather than the soft silent button operation we are used to in more premium products. The printed paperwork enclosed with the product contained spelling mistakes and typos, giving a less than professional impression of the company. I bought it for a specific purpose and will tolerate it rather than enjoy using it.

description: With over 25 years of expertise, We're Advancing Audio Technology one beautifully designed product at a time.
title: I have two other Azatom Dab radios and…
review: I have two other Azatom Dab radios and am very content with them so hense buying this uprated  DBS Plus version. Nice looking. The shape takes up less space than my other Dabs. A very fair price but the tuning setup is not as easy or as intuitive as my other Azatom models, so on day one I am somewhat frustrated but it's probably an age thing.  As with others I know I long for a return to the days of rotary tuning and pressing a numbered button to preset the station.TWO days in and still finding tuning, setting up the presets etc a complete pain and the guide is no helpful or intuitive for me. The radio is very tech clever but not helpful. The Dab plus signal keeps cutting out. Shame it's spoiling my enjoyment of a seemingly very decent little radio. It's now the 15th Feb.  Still no nearer being able to get my head round the presets etc. Generally love the radio but not the controls presets etc. Clever but not user-friendly.

description: With over 25 years of expertise, We're Advancing Audio Technology one beautifully designed product at a time.
title: Difficult to review …
review: Difficult to review as this is second purchase of same model DAB radio in less than 3 years. Internal battery on first model died after 2.5 years. However, whilst it was working, it was a really good radio and am hoping I was just unlucky with first purchase. Have made a note of date of receipt of second purchase and signed up for 3-year warranty this time - just in case!

description: With over 25 years of expertise, We're Advancing Audio Technology one beautifully designed product at a time.
title: I had difficulty in setting up the…
review: I had difficulty in setting up the radio station presets.  Several attempts were made only for the radio to rescan each time, which removed the preset stations.  I eventually succeeded though.  I would have preferred individual buttons for each radio station I have preset - this would make changing stations far easier in the dark at night.

description: With over 25 years of expertise, We're Advancing Audio Technology one beautifully designed product at a time.
title: The Azatom Horizon2 radio alarm clock
review: The Azatom Horizon2 radio alarm clock, the alarm function isn’t very good. It does come on at the set time but at a very low barely audible sound. The volume button doesn’t work either during the alarm period. On switching off and then on again, the volume is to the same pre alarm volume. Otherwise, it’s a tidy compact clock radio of good sound reception and I shall keep it for now.

review: not too sure as i have only had the radio SONANCE T4 a couple of days but it  seems to be ok so i am content with it so far. Its a shame there is no external indicator to show when the radio is charging and charged!

description: With over 25 years of expertise, We're Advancing Audio Technology one beautifully designed product at a time.
title: Good at the price
review: I bought this because I wanted a small alarm with DAB as my local FM transmitter is 20 miles away and only 50 watts power. The DAB signal is OK and noise free. Sound quality is too basy but I will get used to it. When I first set it up my laptop, less than one mtre away picked up blue-tooth but subsequently no luck and the signal not found. Two other speakers I use with projector and to listen to BBC Iplayer sI got BT half an hour later!!
