review: Easy set up including radio station preset and saving. Great sound and tone control ( rare in a machine of this price). Remote works well and at a good distance.However, CD player ( for which I mainly bought it) does not work as it should. It has problems with track No1 on any disc and after a long initial wait, skips straight to No2. must then rewind to get No1. All OK after that. Phoned and had a long "trying out different techniques" session with the boss which was great. Nice to talk to a real, live, human being. Solved things a little. Left it at, "we shall see how it goes."

review: This is the 4th Azatom DAB product we have bought.  Took longer than expected to initialise it - connecting it to the mains and turning it on did not cause it to burst into life as described - but all straightforward once it realised what was expected of it. Good sound quality for a small device and good value. Having spent about £40 on type C rechargeable batteries and a charger, I cannot get the device to work on batteries.  Azatom customer support don't answer the phone or reply to emails.

title: CD player stopped functioning - all CDs stop inside a minute
review: I've had the Azatom Trinity for 18 months. In the last fortnight, it has stopped playing CDs beyond the first 30-50 seconds of the first track. I've tried many different ones and the same thing happens - they stop inside the first minute. You cannot skip to the next track  either. This is clearly not an issue with any of the CDs.  Very disappointing and very disappointed.

description: With over 25 years of expertise, We're Advancing Audio Technology one beautifully designed product at a time.
title: Don't trust AZATOM renewed warranty!
review: On April 2020 I bought an Azatom Multiplex D2 Dab radio based on good reviews. It was registered with a 3 year warranty and all was ok for a while. However in Feb 2021 it had to be replaced under warranty as the LCD display had got so dull it could hardly be seen. The new radio was registerd on their web site with a brand new 3 year warranty which has an expiry date of Feb 2024. But guess what? This display has gone too and since this too has a warranty I tried to claim for a another replacement as stated by them. However they refuse point blank as they say it's only the original 3 year warrant that counts and that this has now expired. But I protested, why did you register it with a another more up to date warranty if you have no intention of honouring it? They have not replied. This is a common fault (I've heard other reviews) but I just want a radio that works properly. They did say they could quote me for repairs, but this cost, with postage would probably nearly be as much as the price of a new radio. Two failing in 3 years and not honouring a warranty that they gave me...when I have to replace this it will not be an Azatom. Avoid them for this reason- go to a more honest company.

title: replacement for another softener
review: Purchased a midi softener to replace an old softener unit that stopped working efficiently.  Straight forward installation and water quickly became softened.  But after a week had an overflow problem.  Monarch’s response was quick and efficient.  A Monarch technician visited and reviewed my installation (all fine) and replaced a motor, all working again in about 30 mins

description: Monarch Water is one of the UK's leading water softener and scale prevention systems manufacturer since 1964, supporting group and independent merchants nationally.
title: Five Stars had it not been for a manufacturer fault
review: This review could have been 5 stars but for a manufacturing defect that made my "Midi HE" salt chamber repeatedly overflow. The Monarch service department responded quickly to my problem, but due to holiday and other commitments I had to defer the visit of Paul (Monarch Engineer) a couple of times. Paul found the problem within 20 minutes. The blue coloured resin chamber had not been fully tightened to the head assembly and had been allowing leaking water into the salt chamber. Paul said this is the first time he had experienced this manufacturing error. Two months on... and all is well. No scale anywhere on sinks, taps, shower trays, shower glass panels etc., etc!Initial set up is easy - especially if you are replacing an existing softener or have the plumbing ready.

review: Delivered promptly, easy to install myself, compact and tidy. Over the last few months it seems to have gotten on with the job quietly and seems more efficient on salt usage than my old one.

description: Monarch Water is one of the UK's leading water softener and scale prevention systems manufacturer since 1964, supporting group and independent merchants nationally.
title: Update
review: Latest:7/03/22The company especially Trevor& Paul have bent over backwards to resolve the problem which may now be the resin. Softener to be changed.  Sign of a quality company that takes its feedback seriously.Only niggle is that I had to determine the problem. Had nothing to do with the ball valve. Recommendation. Check your softener is doing its job regularly during the warranty period.We have had the Midi HE installed for just over 2 years. Have had the engineer out at least three times as the unit fails to recharge automatically .We end up having hard water. Was informed at the last visit that the unit failed to detect dripping ball valve in the loft and as such was not recording total water being used. Total ballony! Replaced ball valve made no difference. So now it has been set to manually recharge every 4 days which makes a mockery of the stated advantages of the unit. Not sure I would recommend this model or company.Also the supposed savings in detergents etc is misleading as purchase , installation salt and maintenance is going to cost at least £160-200/ yr assuming 10 year service life and 2 people in household.

The guarantee is not worth having after 2 years, I certainly wouldn't buy another and my partner will not be recommending them to his customers!My partner contacted the company and was asked if he was trained by them,  after the call he was really annoyed. description: Monarch Water is one of the UK's leading water softener and scale prevention systems manufacturer since 1964, supporting group and independent merchants nationally.
title: Monarch Water - BE AWARE of so called 7 YEAR GUARANTEE all is not what it appears
review: I have a Monarch Midi system which is 5 years old. It has just malfunctioned and filled right up with water, exiting by the overflow. Nothing else is happening and it is dead.As advised by my plumber I have contacted Monarch to request a call out under warranty.I live less than 20 miles from Monarch’s base in Diss, Suffolk.I was told that only parts are covered for 7 years and that labour is only covered for 2 years.As a result I was told that the CALLOUT CHARGE would be £120 for the first hour including the service. The following charge would be at £18 per 15 minutes. I think that £120 is an extortionate charge. You can be sure that their plumber is not earning that amount. It makes a mockery of claiming they are giving a 7 year guarantee. The FULL guarantee is actually ONLY 2 YEARS. Considering the parts are a small amount of a repair I consider the claim of a 7 year guarantee to be misleading.I asked if I could take the unit directly to them as I am so close. I was told over the phone “No that is not possible” as they do not accept repairs direct. They then said, Oh and Covid-19 prevents that. Why bring that up when she has said they do not accept items being brought in directly. Strange considering that shops are open and their plumber is coming to my house.In summary I think that Customer Service from Monarch Water Softeners is VERY POOR and in my opinion I would advise CAUTION in respect of Monarch Water Softeners that CLAIM A 7 YEAR GUARANTEE.I consider somewhat misleading in respect of their guarantee which is only 2 Years for full warranty.BE AWARE.I am publishing reports on various media in this respect.Having made a further phone call today (3rd Sept) I was told that the Sales Director Trevor Woods would call me back, as he was on another call.So far I have not had the courtesy of a phone call back. This is not very impressive, so I would urge caution in dealing with this company.My report has been circulated on many plumbers and wholesalers sites. I have had one reply already, and this plumbers says he'll take a note as he wouldn't want any of his clients having to go through what I have experienced.

title: I was alerted to this company via a…
review: I was alerted to this company via a friend  as Bolton council were doing a scheme in conjunction with the energy companies to help people with health problems ( copd) and other health problems. They would insulate the loft and and put thermostats on the radiators, happy because it was free! Our loft is half boarded and the survey said they would lift the boards in the half boarded loft and fit the the insulation underneath. Well that didn’t happen and they just threw the insulation over the top of the boards making the loft unsafe. We can’t store anything up there now as you don’t know we’re the ends of the boards are , making it unusable.I’m still in touch with them hoping they are going to sort it out. No luck so far! Bolton council you need to read these reviews and clamp down on them.

Keep on waiting and calling them they do not even bothered to make an action about it

title: My mums house is a shambles after these…
review: My mums house is a shambles after these cowboys finsihed working. they uses silicone sealant to put skirting boards on different to the ones that were removed so they stick out.  the walls have been bare plaster for 7 weeks now waiting for them to rectify, my mum is elderly and a severe asthmatic and shes sick right now because of the dust. she has had no curtains up for 7 weeks.  they ignore all correspondence

title: Do not use this company.we applied for…
review: Do not use this company.we applied for the boiler in February and have just been informed we’re not getting one. The customer service is non existent. It’s a miracle if you get to speak to anyone it goes straight to answer phone and they never ring back. We have been waiting 5 months for a boiler with no heating as ours had broken. We were assured we qualified for a boiler. They have now told us our house is energy efficient because we have got sufficient loft insulation and cavity wall insulation so can’t have a boiler even though the boiler isn’t working. If they can’t make money on your insulation you won’t get a boiler. This is a scam.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Excellent shop aid.
review: The service from Rutlands.is always excellent. I ordered these grip blocks with a bit of scepticism tbh. I wasn't sure whether they'd be much good. They weren't..they were far more effective than I had expected! Don't hesitate,just buy them. I wish I had years ago. Thankyou.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Good piece of kit.
review: Bought this piece of kit on one of the daily price reductions. Have messed about with lengths of timber, clamps and repeated measurements in the past to make a ninety degree cross cut. Now I have a great piece of kit making repeat work so much faster. I would recommend this tool to anyone without reservation.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Quick service - great product = decent price
review: Very quick service. Made a few test cuts and it seems like a decent router table. Second workshop tool I've bought from Rutlands - previously purchased a thicknesser which I am really happy with.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Rutland is an absolute game changer
review: Rutland was recommended to me last year, since then I have purchased quite a few items, wether I’ve driven over and collected or used their postal service the response and delivery time has been fabulous. The equipment and tools I have purchased have been an absolute game changer for me and now I wouldn’t go anywhere else .

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: One very happy little camper…
review: I had been in the market for a top quality router lift/motor combo for some time. After doing loads of research online, shopping with Rutlands was a no-brainer, the process was almost too easy. I placed my order 23.12.24 and received it on my doorstep 27.12.24, incredibly well packed, in New Zealand! The transparency/communication and speed of delivery is just outstanding.....not to mention the robust quality of the product! One very happy little camper!!

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Good quality product
review: Good quality product, delivered quickly.Compared to other products that cost a lot more than these you cannot go wrong.Recommend item.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: I couldn't be happier.
review: Excellent quality tools and first class service. I'll definitely make Rutlands a go-to company for my tools and accessories from now on.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Fantastic
review: Fantastic, top quality vice made for the discerning workshop! I have been looking for a versatile 360 degree swivel vice forever. After coming across this web site and reading other reviews I was tempted by the discounted price, I am not disappointed at all. At full price it’s a fantastic vice but discounted like I purchased it was incredible value. Rutlands is my new favourer shop.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Excellent response to issues
review: Excellent service even when dealing with issues. I received a damaged item in my shipment, which was still usable after minor repairs, but I was given a full refund without questions. This response is rare these days and greatly appreciated.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: My hobby is I am very pleased with the quality of the cutters and other devices!
review: My hobby is carpentry. I prefer to have a quality tool and I must say. that "rutland" fully meets my requirements for the quality of goods on the counter. I purchased two cutters and a couple more devices I needed. The prices in the store are quite reasonable but not low. I recommend the store to those who value the result of their work and do not want to waste time.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Bench grinder and sharpening jig.
review: As per usual delivery was excellent. My only issue is I purchased 2 items. A bench grinder which I am very pleased with and a lathe tool sharpening jig. The only reason I have scored 4 stars is there are no instructions with the jig. After the purchase I visited Rutland's web site to see if I could download a instruction sheet. I could not find a download. I then looked at the reviews for the sharpening jig and a previous customer had found the same issue. He advised to look up Wolverine web site and download the instructions from there. He was totally right. With the instructions you do have to follow the measurements for installation, as measurements are critical. Please Rutland's heed the advice to insure instructions are with the jig or at least downloadable from your site.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Easy purchase process
review: Purchasing at Rutlands has been easy for me since I started getting a few products this year.Selection and purchase process is smooth and clear.Unfortunately one of the products I got this time, the 35mm adaptor for the cyclone dust collector doesn't fit in the cyclone port.It seems that the cyclone dust collector port diameter has been changed, or at least in the one I received.The adaptor has a bigger diameter than the hole where it's supposed to fit in.Apart of this, I'm quite happy with the products I purchased so far, reasonable quality at a reasonable price.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: The item was excellent quality as…
review: The item was excellent quality as expected. The packing and postage costs are a bit of a joke, and very expensive.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Easy18 volt battery pinner/ nail gun…
review: Easy site to use and product delivered the next day looked great but not tested as its a gift. Downside no case for the tool so had to purchase a box to suit and unable to use 10.00 off discount voucher for purchase due to Web error

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Tight fitting Flip stops
review: Good quality stops, except that with a base of over 19.2mm they were too tight to fit and slide easily in 19 mm track in the way they are supposed to. Queried this with Rutlands, who were helpful, but before they'd come up with a solution I decided to take matters into my own hands and two minutes with a file fixed the issue.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Bought some 600mm f clamps
review: Bought some 600mm f clamps.  I have some of the same clamps.  These are branded "Rutland".  I don't see any difference.  The plastic non making faces used to fall off. Easily rectified with a dot of adhesive.  Not sure about these but they are perfectly good clamps and work well.  Even better when they're on special offer.  Good quality like all the hand tools I have purchased.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Brilliant product well build and well…
review: Bought the orbit sander, Brilliant product well build and well priced, works brilliantly and does the job well, only issue is the dust extractor bag is on the loose side so blows the dust out the gap.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Clamps,adaptors and abrasive cleaners
review: I bought table saw clamps dust collection stepped adaptor and a large abrasive belt and disk cleaner.  Have not used them yet hence the 4 stars  but they appear to be to the high standard of item that rutland sells.  The abrasive cleaner is large and should last for many months if not longer.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Partial order delivery but full refund on missing part and delivery
review: I ordered two countersink drill bits advertised in a sale and although they ran out of the smaller one. They refunded me for the second one and dropped me a note to apologise along with a refund of the delivery costs.Service response gets 5 stars but I wish they had the 2mm bit in stock, hence only 4 this time.Thanks, Rutlands, for your prompt response 👍

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Japanese saws
review: Bought 3 saws for a Christmas present.  They were delivered in a few days. Well wrapped in bubble plastic.  They are individually packaged and appear to be good quality.  Not used yet hence 4 stars. However i expect them to perform well like other Rutland products

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Great after sales sevice
review: The drill guide I purchased, which arrived on time and was of reasonable quality (as far as I could tell), didn't fit my drill bit. I emailed the company explaining the situation and was promised a full refund on return of the item which I received very promptly. Thank you. I'd have awarded 5 stars if I'd been refunded the £7.00 P&P.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Well worth a look
review: I am a hobby woodworker and have used Rutlands a number of times There service is always efficient and I have been happy with my purchase. The quality of the items is not always reflected in the price but there are some bargains to be found and I have been able to afford useful stuff that is out of reach for other suppliers

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: The quality of tools I have purchased…
review: The quality of tools I have purchased are excellent as is the sevice. One quibble I have is the cost of postage on smaller items like replacement carbide tips otherwise I would have given my review 5 stars

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: High quality promptly delivered
review: Products have always arrived promptly are well packaged and are of good quality. I've not yet had reason to use their customer services however.Delivery is expensive for small items.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: A solid piece of kit.
review: A solid piece of kit.Some of the gearing needed a bit of attention and the instructions are not the greatest but when you get it together it works as expected.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Usual competitive price and prompt…
review: Usual competitive price and prompt delivery from Rutland. BUT as we are used to with Chinese made kit the manuals are not that useful. The display on this caliber flashes most of the time. No idea why and not covered in the manual. Otherwise fine but haven’t checked the accuracy against a set a slip gauges yet.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Great
review: Great, well made, and useful products but one star missing above because of the heavy postage charges.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Great tool, box ready on arrival
review: Tool arrived with very little assembly required. Cuts straight and square from the off so very please with that. I also bought a precision blade and swapping this was straightforward, although the instructions weren’t great. The clamp is a really useful item and easy to use. Also like the led light to give you the guide line.Bought for occasional use, initially flooring and skirting boards but and also planning to use for a timber frame workshop- very pleased with my purchase

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Pocket Hole Jig
review: Ordered a three hole pocket hole jig.  It was on sale.  Came in a few days.  Very very nice product.  Well made and smooth and all fits together nicely and feels solid and satisfying.  Thoughtfully included were some poster screws and dowels to get me started.  Very happy.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: 600mm T Rule
review: Rule arrived well secured in a foam tray. Measuring the right angle bracket over its own length it was 1mm out. However, the bracket is easily adjusted via two Allen key screws, with an included Allen key

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Slightly Disappointed
review: My purchase was the R15 Router Lift with Motor offer and it’s awesome and deserves a five Star rating. However I need to have a moan! So only a three star this time. On 23rd December, I placed my order. On the 24th, it arrived. Again… Awesome. However there was no motor. I doubted if I had read the deal correctly but I hadn’t, it was definitely included the motor. I double checked the delivery details and the order said… Delivered. This disturbed me I tried to contact Rutlands via their website then by phone but for the life of me I couldn’t find a phone number. This concerns me! I know that we are all covered by the three year warranty's, but how do we contact Rutlands in the event of a claim. I’m still waiting for a reply to my emails. Meanwhile the motor has finally arrived, via Parcel Force. Maybe it would have helped if the boxes would have been clearly marked 1 of 2 and 2 of 2. Maybe all this was caused by the Christmas break and no one working, but we still are receiving many offers and requests for reviews. Sorry guys my confidence level has dropped.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: The quality of Rutland’s machinery &…
review: The quality of Rutland’s machinery & accessories (in my opinion) is exceptional. I have a lathe that I bought from a guy who had owned it for 6months & was ‘going bigger’. I have a couple of chucks as well. ALL EXCEPTIONAL QUALITY. Where I have an issue is postal charges. For example I bought a chuck screw £10. Postage was £7+. As it happens, Rutland had advertised the item as a Screw Chuck - a play on words? Anyway, I sent it back. & they refunded me £10. This mix-up for a part weighing 100grams or so would have fitted into a cardboard sleeve, costing far less postage. Rant over.All in all FANTASTIC QUALITY, but at a premium.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Limited postage options!
review: 3 separate recent orders where I was charged for 24 hour delivery and not one of them turned up within 2 to 3 days. I know it is difficult, but give an alternative postage option on checkout. I have reported this issue previously on another occasion....

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Quite unimpressed by the quality
review: Quite unimpressed by the quality. It didn't fit my Dewalt router which means I now have to start tweaking it, drilling new holes and countersinking the supplied base plate. The instructions were inadequate and Rutlands are a bit over enthusiastic with the number of offer emails they send. Will unsubscribe and think very hard before using again.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: the saw want to bad init self apart…
review: the saw want to bad init self apart from trying to get it to stay on track with out movement the cams  kept coming loose and dust extraction wasn’t there at all i had saw dust everywer i even taped over the hole where you undo the blade didn’t make any difference

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Disappointed
review: Disappointed that the guide rail for the track saw didn't have any clamps and couldn't see that on the description nor were they offered as an extra - which the joining bars were.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: very poor packaging
review: very poor packaging. nail gun with 2 additional packs of nails just posted in guns own flimsy box. Box fell to bits in post, received gun and nails in a plastic bag with items damaged.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Always good service, questionable review rules
review: Always good service. Some of the tools ard better than others, but thats expected from the pricepoint.Unfortunately Rutlands delete any reviews of tools that are not 4 or 5 star, or have any type of negativity against the tool. This is very dishonest trading and misleading for other would-be purchasers.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Bad Comms Lose Stars
review: Reasonably priced products that perform well on the whole. As a professional user this is important. Will no doubt be using again when need arises. HOWEVER. No provision of telephone comms is , frankly, incredibly annoying and frustrating. Esp as this is not mirrored by any of their rivals whom are more than willing to invite phone enquiries and not “hide” behind email only platforms! 99.99% of communication on this planet is carried out verbally and Rutlands would be well minded to realise this & imho would benefit from its implementation. You can’t build a rapport via email.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Good stuff, let down by lack of instructions.
review: I have bought a number of products from this company over the last 2 months. All appear to be well made and of high quality. Delivery is next day, but I am frustrated by the lack of instructions and/or guidance. For example I bought a toggle clamp plate, but before I could use it, I needed to buy a slider bar - another £7 delivery charge. Might be obvious, you might say but I have never used one before. Now the slider bar has arrived, I cannot see how the clamp plate fits as the holes do not align. I shall have to stop buying their products as I am accumulating pieces which I cannot use.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Good products - difficult to communicate with.
review: I've been using Rutlands for many years and have been pleased with quality of their products. Some time ago they scrapped their customer support telephone line and I find them far harder to communicate with. I recently purchased a pair of saw horses and they arrived firmly locked together with no hint as to how to separate them. No 'phone line to call for advice.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Vice with Clamp
review: Rutland.com order response was very good with a quick follow update on delivery. Delivery next day was very welcome.The vice was a good weight and size but its condition was not as expected. It looked dirty and used and the 2 guide rails were heavily pitted, it did not look like the photos on Rutland's website. Having said that it cleaned up fairly well and is doing the job it's intended for.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: The mitre saw was not good, but customer service excellent
review: Unfortunately the goods arrived damaged which wasn’t apparent until trying to operate the mitre saw.  A quick email to Rutlands customer service, which was answered very quickly, enabled me to return the saw and obtain a full refund.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Not what we expected
review: The tools we received look like they are made of different types of wood - at least, they are all different colours and one has a different grain.  When my husband picked up one of the chisels, the handle fell off. I expect it was glued inadequately. We spent a lot of money on this gift and I am not happy that I have given him tools that were rated so highly, and are not what we were given to expect. They will perform their job but I am disappointed.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Great products that are well thought out.
review: Great products that are well thought out. My only issue is shipping. I live in Cyprus, Rutland have a drop down menu for shipping locations to all of the EU. Cyprus  is not on their list. I have contacted them to arrange shipping but no reply so far. So since Rutland are the only company that make the Item I need. I had to use a third party shipper with a UK address. This then cost a ridiculous amount to ship the €30 worth of product. Hopefully we can resolve this soon as I would like to purchase other items.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: The table saw is great - but poor customer communication
review: The table saw is great; far better quality than I imagined at a really good price. Sadly, delivered a week after it was promised, with poor customer communication - none at all until I emailed (the only way of making contact) after it was already late.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Bowl Gouge size
review: Rutlands sell a 3/8 inch bowl gouge. In the UK this should mean that the flute width is 3/8 inch. This gouge from Rutlands has a 3/8 inch shaft and the flute width is much smaller. The small print in the online description did mention the flute size but, come on Rutlands, stick to UK convention when selling here!

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: OK if used with great care.
review: Quick service and useful kit (loose tenon jig).  However the perspex template is very fragile and I needed a new one after an hour which was supplied but at my cost: the brass collet required hours of work on the router to make it fit and all the loose tenons supplied require sanding back to make them fit the routed mortices. Nevertheless it is neater, quicker and more accurate than using a chisel.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Good quality and prompt delivery, BUT
review: Good quality and prompt delivery, but not provided with any instructions on how to use, or set up. Sometimes customer services reply to a query, and sometimes they don't.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Bought bobbin sander brushes
review: Bought bobbin sander but after quite short period of use the carbon brushes needed replacing. No spares on Rutland web site so had to contact by email. They came back and offered part but no picture or even description, just " miscellaneous part"I ordered items which I thought were quite expensive, but when they arrived they were just bare brushes and springs, no brass brush holders. Fitting involved unbending brass holders inserting part and re bending. I seem to have got away with it this time but that probably could not be done again without the brass part breaking. Poor communications on Rutland's part I think

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Sadly I purchased 2m long flexible…
review: Sadly I purchased 2m long flexible router guide,it is totally useless  as it flexs between fixing centres giving a scallop shape.I suggest this products should  be withdrawn to avoid other disappointed customers

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: British Chinese standards
review: What they do say on their website is that their bench planes and I would assume the vast majority of their tools are 'Manufactured to British Standards, Rutlands® hand planes are recommended..'However what they fail to mention anywhere on their site is that the No.4 hand plane I ordered, manufactered to british standards, is actually a Quangsheng Luban... the image on the website hides the name and there is no mention it being manufactured in China..

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Delivery good, product not so much
review: Delivery was fine but the product itself is questionable. Brought the circular saw, can't get it to cut square on and size piece of wood. Base seems to bend when you tighten it in place, check squareness using a engineer set square but still can't get it to set square or cut square. Would return but used the product and been a couple of weeks since the purchase.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: You'd be better off going elsewhere.
review: They do not take responsibility......everything is someone else's fault. They go through the motions, though do not rectify the fault. Really don't know how they receive so many positive reviews, unless it's like another customer suggested........they only publish the good reviews.Really think you'd be better off going elsewhere.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Happy with the product disappointed with the courier …
review: Happy with the product and the service from Rutlands but the delivery by parcel force was dire my parcel was left on the top of shared postbox’s in the communal area of our shared building with no attempt to contact us . I was amazed the parcel was not taken.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: hmmmm
review: Fast service and well packaged but rubbish product. Looks like it had been slung together by a 2 year old. Rutlands...If you cannot understand that your customers expect quality don't place yourself that high up the market scale. I purchased the carving chisels. The design makes them impossible to hone. I paid £60. They are only worth £20 from the local market stall!!

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Saw great, stand poor
review: I'm sorry but it is obvious that whoever made the saw didn't make the stand, the saw was great, but the stand  is badly designed with having to bolt the saw to it, an easier and quicker way must be possible. Also it took forever to arrive, and there were some nuts and bolts missing.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Useless for beginners
review: The Rutland thicknesser came with good reviews and was a good price. But - as with so many of these things - assumes a good knowledge and experience, so pretty rubbish for beginners like me.  The only real operating instruction in the instructions is ‘here’s the start button’.  Some of it I’ve been able to figure out, but I can’t even find a YouTube video specifically for this machine (other than the Rutland sale video). At one point it talks about wax. What type of wax? Car wax? Furniture wax? Candle wax? Ear wax? So I’ve got an expensive machine that I’m going to have to experiment on, and just hope I don’t damage it.

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: Router fence clamps
review: Purchased 2 x router fence clamps which are really well made but the slide guides are too wide and need altering which is not difficult but the guides should have just been simply replaced rather than the ordeal of sending back etc. always been pleased with the service from Rutlands but they’ve let themselves down here!

description: Established in 1999, Rutlands® is a market leader in the design, development and direct sales of premium woodworking tools.
title: A waste of money
review: Order placed and payment taken Friday evening. Next day delivery compulsory at £7.  Rutland gave the item to the courier Monday evening.  Courier delivered to me Wednesday evening.   Item is a blower not a vacuum.  Anything larger than fine dust gets stuck in the grill that protects the fan motor.  A waste of money.

description: House Builder
title: Amazing experience
review: From start to finish our experience with Wain homes has been amazing! Excellent customer service and always on hand to answer any questions, nothing was too silly. Jodie at Keyford on the Green Frome has been fantastic, always there with a smile and a helping hand. Would definitely recommend her to our friends. We love our home! :)

description: House Builder
title: Trevemper, Newquay
review: My partner and I recently moved into to Trevemper, Newquay and we are so happy with the house. We worked with Niamh throughout the whole process and she was (and still is) super helpful. We were able to view the plot at every stage of the build and have any of our questions answered immediately. Since moving in site have promptly seen to any issues we had, albeit only minor, and they are always just a phone call away. Would definitely recommend to any other first time buyers.

description: House Builder
title: Great staff on site who are always…
review: Great staff on site who are always respectful of the residents & going the extra mile.Shingie is an asset & was constantly in touch and sorting appointments for the very minor fixes.Top experience compared to buying from previous new build companies.

description: House Builder
title: We are extremely happy with wainhome.
review: We are extremely happy with wainhome. The service we have received from Karen, at sales office at Linley Grange  has been incredible. From the very first day we arrived at her office and all through the process, she has been amazing and very professional. I would especially like to thank Karen, for her exceptional help throughout the entire housing process. Her knowledge, patience, and dedication made everything so much easier for us. She is always available to answer our questions and went above and beyond to ensure our questions was satisfied. Thank you so much Karen, for making this such a positive experience. We can't wait to move into our new home.Thank you. Stanley & Evelyn.

description: House Builder
title: Ian - Site Manager
review: The service we have received from Ian (Site Manager) at Rectory Woods has been incredible!! He’s been amazing and really helpful, looked after us from day 1, any issues or snags no matter how little were done quick as possible, we are very happy, best decision we have made is to move here, lovely cozy home, all the building team who have also supported have been fab!

description: House Builder
title: Service is above and beyond especially…
review: Service is above and beyond especially Jodie and Sam with a build quality to match, very happy with our house and a big Thankyou to all the team at Keyford on the Green Frome.

description: House Builder
title: Talbot Manor
review: Purchased a property at Talbot Manor, Whitchurch in September. We found the buying process really easy and managed to complete very quickly. Thanks to Ashley for being so helpful and approachable throughout this process. On the whole, we’ve found the quality of our new property very good. Yes there have been snags, and there’s still a couple outstanding, but we will get there eventually. I would say that one or two of the contractors they use are not up to standard (plumbing) which causes much frustration and delays in work being completed. We would still recommend Wain homes, and would definitely choose them again in the future.

description: House Builder
title: A stressful time made easy
review: Our experience has been very positive and straightforward, every step of the process is discussed and made easy to follow, plus Karen at Linley Grange has been like an old friend from the start.Thanks!

description: House Builder
title: We are extremely happy with wain homes
review: We are extremely happy with wain homes.   From speaking to Karen in the sales office to after care with Chris the site manager at linley grange,  stalmine.  We had his company works number to ring if there was any issues when we moved in.  There was one and it was dealt with immediately. Chris called 2 weeks after moving in just to check everything was OK.  All the contractors on the site are helpful and friendly.

description: House Builder
title: Ashley has been great very helpful…
review: Ashley has been great very helpful can’t do enough for us, very informative easy to speak to, lovely lad. He has gone above & beyond had a lot of patience because we did have a lot questions can’t fault him to be honest . We met Danny during the welcome meeting, he answered all questions and was very helpful. We both can’t wait to move in & both  confident Wain Homes will look after us

description: House Builder
title: We're Really Pleased!
review: My wife and I decided to go down the part-exchange route to purchase our new Wain Home (this is painless by the way) at the new Trevemper (Newquay) site, and we've been really pleased with the way things have turned out. The first person we dealt with was Niamh (sales office) and she was (and still is!) extremely helpful. She even took in parcels for us when we were out!. Basically, Niamh made things as easy as she could for us from start to finish, letting us know what was happening (and when) during the process - and if she didn't know something she would ensure she got the answer for us. We would not hesitate to use the part-ex route again (although it's doubtful we'll move again anytime soon!) but I must reiterate that Niamh played a big part in helping us. There were only a few issues raised but they were soon identified and dealt with. Well done Niamh!.

description: House Builder
title: Trevemper
review: Niamh at Trevemper was a pleasure to deal with from the start. Excellent communication and prompt to address any issues. Although there were a few snags they were rectified quickly.

description: House Builder
title: Higher Trewhiddle
review: We purchased our new Wain Home property 4 months ago with initial and continued guidance and support from Jodie in the sales office at Higher Trewhiddle. We are most grateful to you, Jodie, for providing answers to our many questions across varying subjects! A  credit to Wain Homes! We have since had other issues including snagging lists, dealt with promptly by the extremely friendly site team and currently feel very settled on this site.

description: House Builder
title: Great overall experience as a first time buyer!
review: Very helpful team, always willing to help when i've had any concerns. Found the entire buying / moving process to be very straight forward as a first time buyer. It's been 6 weeks since I moved in & the customer service team are still in touch regularly to make sure everythings ok. Ollie from the site team & Paul from customer care have been particularly helpful & reassuring

description: House Builder
title: Calder View
review: We originally looked at the Cottam site but visited Calder View to look at the show house  we were interested in. We liked the area that much we decided to purchase a property at Calder View. Karen was very helpful and didn’t mind our constant visits and questions, keeping us up to date through our purchasing journey. After completion there has been a couple of things crop up which needed quick attention before we submit our snagging list and Karen has been able to resolve these quickly. Calder View is a lovely place to live. There is still building work going on but site workmen are friendly and very helpful.

description: House Builder
title: Calder View
review: Calder ViewSmall snag list now complete.A big thankyou to Jim (site manager), Kyle (site plumber) and to Lewis (deputy site manager).Thankyou Lewis for your professionalism,co-ordination, kindness and care.A true asset to Wainhomes. As work is still on-going the site is kept immaculate.The roads are kept clear and the road cleaner is always out.The work force are helpful and friendly.Thankyou!

description: House Builder
title: Calder View- Catterall
review: Calder View- CatterallWe have exchanged contracts on our new house and hope to be moving in at the end of August. I just wanted to say how impressed we have been with the sales manager Linda, who initially dealt with us and offers fantastic customer service, updates and feedback. She is a true star and has made our experience so far very pleasant and exciting. We do hope this continues and we can give further positive reviews once we have moved in.Sally & Mark Jennings

description: House Builder
title: Mike mainly but also Paul who came to…
review: Mike mainly but also Paul who came to help him for a short time, they were both very good and sorted out some outstanding snags, Mike came in first and checked his list to see what he had to do then just got on with it, quite a list to put right so he was busy here most of the day. Still has the gate to do another time because of rain. He explained everything he was doing, very nice chap.

description: House Builder
title: Wain homes completed work .
review: I have lived at Lawton green for a year an a half now and as with all new builds there’s a snag list as long as your arm ! although slow at start once all the jobs had been booked in by Sam the works started to be completed.I had a few leaks and issues but all got sorted ✔️ when I had a terrible leak in the kitchen Sam got the floors replaced , skirting removed and replaced and all the plnths and fittings sorted . Although it was a little stressful it has all been Fixed and I would like to thank Sam and the contractors for all the help toRectify all the problems to our satisfaction.Kind regards Gaz and Kath

description: House Builder
title: Squirrels Chase
review: We moved into our wonderful Squirrels Chase home a month ago and are very happy with the style/design of the house and the overall very good quality of the fittings/finish.  Like any new house there have been a few snags but we have been very pleased with the team's attempts to correct them in a timely fashion.We'd like to give special thanks to sales representatives Elaine Smith, Linda Collins and site manager Nigel Bickmore who have always made extra efforts to ensure our satisfaction with our lovely new home, and are always very friendly, knowledgeable and competent.  All are a credit to Wainhomes.

description: House Builder
title: Talbot Manor three months in
review: The purchase of our home went without problems, Linda assisted us during the process and we are very satisfied. We have now been at Talbot Manor for three months and so far only minor snags. Since Dave Adams the new site manager arrived all snags have now been addressed. We are very pleased with the house and the assistance received from Dave.

description: House Builder
title: Lawton Green - Alsager
review: This is my third Wain Homes purchase over the past 14 years and I have to commend the evolution of the company. Anita was a pleasure to work with during the buying process. Oliver the site manager has been great at ensuring snags are resolved quickly and checking in that everything is working as intended in our new home!  Possibly one of the friendliest/efficient teams of all the new builds I have purchased.

description: House Builder
title: Crown Point
review: We are facing some usual UK-new build problems in here such as door size not fit into frame, glass block and wall tiles in the shower rooms are not fixed with glue lead to water seepage (some water stains on the wall, garage as well ),bad painting, the handle of the wooden door to the garden is broken. We moved in for few weeks already and still waiting for all of these to be fixed.Luckily the site manager, Paul is always willing to help here. He comes and fix very quickly while we see him around. He deserves a five-star. Just hope no big problem.

description: House Builder
title: Cat I'th' Window
review: We moved into our first new build home on the Cat I'th Window development in Standish at the beginning of May. As expected there were a number of snags to resolve but the aftercare from Danny, Rich and their team has been (and continues to be) great and the vast majority of issues have been resolved promptly and to a high standard. Danny has been great at coordinating the repairs with minimal disturbance to ourselves. Not to forget Suzanne, who was very friendly and helpful with the purchase and initial care. We are very happy with our first home.

description: House Builder
title: We moved into a Shakespeare on Lawton…
review: We moved into a Shakespeare on Lawton Green at the start of June. We love our new home. Yes, there were a few snags, but that was to be expected, and to be honest, they aren't majors, Oliver from the site office has worked really hard to get everything on my list sorted, he has kept us updated on progress and has been on hand when needed.  We are just waiting on Panorama to come and replace a poorly fitted piece around the extractor, they are proving to be a little elusive.We had a few quibbles with the sales office pre move, I would suggest any new buyers to ask for any questions or requests to be sent by email. I soon realised that if it isn't written down it's very easy for sales to say it wasn't discussed.

description: House Builder
title: So Far So Good
review: It was touch and go whether our purchase would be completed before the mortgage deadline ran out but the sales team thankfully played their part in making it happen just in time.Only had the keys for three weeks but the site team have been helpful in arranging to sort a number of snagging issues. I even have the site manager's number so it all looks very promising.Elaine

description: House Builder
title: We moved onto the Paddocks estate in…
review: We moved onto the Paddocks estate in Preston in 2020. There are some good lads on this site. Right from the start we were looked after by Wes and the tele-handler Tom who works very hard and knows everyone. The former Site Manager Sam Snow went the extra mile for us a few times, and the new SM Dave continues the high customer service ethic. In terms of snags, we have had a few issues which have been mostly dealt with now - persistence with the customer care team is key. Communication could sometimes be improved. It’s sad to read such negative reviews and experiences of other developments. I can only assume that The Paddocks is one of the better-run Wainhomes sites and the company should be credited for this one.

description: House Builder
title: Great after care
review: My overall experience with Wainhomes has been a little up and down from the moment we reserved. However, this review will be based on the after care experience and for that I cannot thank Sam from the Head Office team and Dave the site manager at Talbot Manor enough. We had a lot of issues and they have helped to get these sorted as soon as possible.

description: House Builder
title: Just been here around 1 month
review: Just been here around 1 month, so far is happy with it though some trivial issues would rather doing on own than waiting for their repair team.

description: House Builder
title: Latune Gardens
review: We are looking forward to moving into first ever new build at Latune Gardens, Lathom. George has been extremely accommodating and supportive throughout the entire buying process. This is an exciting time for us and I hope that the level of care and attention continues after we move into our new home.

description: House Builder
title: We committed to purchase the property…
review: We committed to purchase the property we had delays you took it off the market and then put it back on the market £10k dearer

description: House Builder
title: Main office bad contractors great!
review: Main office are terrible at booking, took them forever. Raised the issue in Feb and got sorted late July after 3 inspections.However the work completed by Mike and Chris excellent and great individuals.

description: House Builder
title: Wainhomes Pinford estate Broughton Preston
review: We moved into a 5 bedroom house on the Pinfold Estate in March 2024. A professional Snagger recorded a large number of faults mainly attributed to poor workmanship by contractors We cant praise enough the work of James the site manager and Samantha the assistant site manager who have done an excellent job of dealing with the snags we encountered in a professional and courteous way

description: House Builder
title: Wainhomes North West.
review: Wainhomes North West.After completion of the Linley Grange site in Stalmine over a year ago, the roads have not been swept.It will be 2 or 3 years before the roads are adopted by the council, therefore it is the responsibility of the developer to maintain the roads.The gutters are now full of dust and mud and grass and weeds are growing nicely.A very poor advertisement for the builder.Despite several phone calls I cannot get to speak to anyone who will respond to my complaint.

description: House Builder
title: Aftercare
review: Hello, we bought a home as shared ownership through wain homes/Cornwall housing. We were told before we moved in to write out a snagging list and someone from wain homes would come around and fix everything, to date no one has and it is now 1 year and 3 months. No one from wain homes has even tried to contact us and have tried also Cornwall housing many times as well and not even a phone call/ email . Home is lovely but after care is appaling !

description: House Builder
title: Squirrels Chase: Updated Review
review: Original Review:Had a wonderful experience from Wainhomes North West. Massive thanks to all the staff who've helped us but have to make special mention of Elaine who helped us secure our dream home and kept us informed throughout the start of our journey.Update:Unfortunately since we were asked to write the previous review we have had ongoing issues with it taking 6 months to initially complete the snagging review - most snags still haven't been repaired despite me taking several days off work to allow them access to our property. The site is still left unfinished, with the roads and paths needing tarmac and street lights installing.We still have a beautiful house but as people have previously mentioned it would be much more enjoyable if we weren't constantly chasing for jobs to be done.

description: House Builder
title: Great Sales Process, Okay Build
review: The purchasing process was great. Linda in the showhome was fantastic and a joy to work with. Upon moving in we had numerous snags, some quite major, however these were fixed quickly once a new site manager came along. Still some cosmetic things we are not 100% happy with, but now feel it's not worth the effort of trying to resolve and will just live with. Love the look of our estate and presentation of the estate. This is not our first newbuild and I feel not the same quality build as we have had elsewhere.

description: House Builder
title: Site Team is extremely good
review: Site Team is extremely good. The Customer Care well, what can I say… we have moved in for over 3 months now and we are still waiting for our snags list to be completed. There has been communications from customer care to tell us where they are with the snags etc.

description: House Builder
title: First home in a lovely area
review: Positives - We received fabulous service and help from Heather Thompson based in the sales office. Heather is a lovely lady & always went above & beyond for us. As first time buyers she kept us updated throughout the process of buying our home which we appreciated loads. Thank you for all you have done Heather! Negatives - Head Office are not great. Communication is poor. Their sub-contractors who do snags also lack communication. We had builders who left stones down the drain which caused our WC to be blocked. We had our snag appointment arranged which we took the day off for, but yet nobody turned up & we received no update from head office until we called them to chase where the site manager was to be told nobody is coming out & there had been a mess up on their admin site - appalling excuse. The builders had also left the garden in a state! We understood that it would not of been turfed, but there was building mess left & tons of glass everywhere! Metal gates have been dumped behind our fencing which also makes it look horrible.

description: House Builder
title: Keep waiting in for glass to be fitted…
review: Keep waiting in for glass to be fitted and now told again that they cant find it or it may be broken, this is the third time in the last 6 weeks, it's becoming an annoying joke. Nothing ever gets done quickly, there is always another problem. I was told on Thursday that they had the glass and fitters would be here today. I'm very patient but I cant hang around forever. After sales service is not great. We love the house but need just a small few problems sorted.

description: House Builder
title: Lovely home but after sales care dealing with snags has been poor
review: Our house on Lawton Green, Alsager is lovely and we are happy with it. Anita in sales was very good, approachable and helpful throughout. We moved in, in August 2021 and had quite a big snag list. A lot of the stuff has been done but we still have items not dealt with 9 months later. Had the snag list been dealt with better the score would have been better. It’s felt like we have been forgotten about and had to keep chasing getting anything done. The site staff have concentrated on building the new homes after we have moved in, but haven’t really cared about dealing with the snags. We have had to chase over and over to try and get things resolved.

description: House Builder
title: Slow to action issues, poor communication and workmanship with limited willingness to accept accountability
review: I purchased a Wain Homes property last year, admittedly on the location (proximity to railway station) over the development itself. While the property is a nice size and layout, Wain Homes haven't been the easiest of companies to deal with. Snagging issues have taken months to resolve, and the lack communication and accountability from contractors from the on-site teams (both Sales and Construction) has left alot to be desired. Even when things have been actioned I haven't been too impressed with the quality of workmanship.  The one exception to this is the service provided by Amy Oelofse in customer care. She's always kept on top of chasing contractors and keeping me informed as to her progress (even when there is none from site). It is Amy's handling of this plot since taking over from the site team that has given Wain Homes the number of chances  they were before I escalated their poor handling into their formal complaints process, and her support is the only reason this is not a 1-star review.I didnt expect any new build to be plain sailing (the industry only has itself to blame for its bad reputation) and while it seems Wain Homes are one of the better ones, my experience still is far from them "doing things the right way" as they claim in their marketing materials.

description: House Builder
title: We have recently bought a house on…
review: We have recently bought a house on Pinfold Manor Preston.The Sales lady Lorraine Brown has been very lovely throughout our experience.She is very friendly very professional and has been there for us every step of the way throughout the buying process.if the builders were as good and as thorough as Lorraine I don’t think there would be as many issues.Lorraine has given 100% all time throughout the last 12 months to ensure we have the best experience and support. And is well thought of by many of the home owners on the estate,Who cannot speak highly enough of her. Lorraine is a credit to wainhomes.Sadly we have experienced some issues throughout our purchase with plans not being quite right where inner wall was nearly built incorrectly. Once we had completed we then booked a professional snagger who found quite a few major things that weren’t within building regulations and lots of other smaller issues too which prevented us from being able to move in. We would definitely recommend anyone considering buying a new build to book a professional snagger before they move in. The new site manager Danny who came after our issues had been identified has a been very nice and has got on with a lot of our issues.We are currently going through the complaints process but so far despite being unable to live on our new house for over 3 weeks no suggestion of any sort of compensation for the fact we’re having to pay 2 mortgages at the moment has been even taken into consideration just told it’s not something they offer which I find is shocking!

description: House Builder
title: Lawton Green
review: I have been in my house for 3 months now and although I expected snags as you would with any new build, I did get more than I bargained for which I have had no problem raising with Wainhomes and feeding back through requested surveys. What has been a good experience for me and the reason I have given 3 stars on here is because of the way in which the site manager and assistant site manager have dealt with my concerns, sorting out some of the bigger issues which in turn has taken away a lot of the initial stress. They have been on hand since moving in offering advice and finding solutions as quickly as possible and I have no reason to doubt their continued support if required.I know some reviews on here regarding the customer care department have been negative but my own experience has been positive so far.

description: House Builder
title: Progress
review: Finally getting somewhere few snags left then I will update my review again.

description: House Builder
title: Kingsley Manor - Still Problems 22/05
review: First of all, the house is beautifully designed and fits our family perfectly. We got a surveyor in to snag the property when we moved in (March ‘23) and found a large number of small snags. Ken, the Site Manager, has worked tirelessly through this list and we’re almost there in completing them all.We had quite a few leaks when we first moved in and the central heating didn’t work but again, Ken did everything in his power to get it sorted in a reasonable time frame.A few of the more “serious snags” have taken longer to resolve but this has mainly been down to the 3rd parties (new glass, insulation issues, warped doors, upvc installation errors) that Wain Homes have used on this estate. Again, Ken has persisted with the 3rd parties and we are seeing progress in these areas.On the whole, the process hasn’t been perfect, but to expect perfection in complex situations like this is unreasonable as there are so many moving parts, processes and 3rd parties involved.What I can say is Ken, the site manager, is a decent bloke working in sometimes very challenging circumstances and to think he has to do all the work and give all the effort he has done for us, for potentially 50-100 more houses, is nothing short of a testament to the effort he gives to be friendly, honest and reasonable while maintaining the company’s reputation and sticking to sometimes inhibitive processes.This review is accurate at the time and date it was submitted. There is an ongoing issue which is currently in flight but I trust will be resolved correctly. However, should it not be, this review will be subject to change.Trade Scores:Designers - 10/10Groundworkers - 7/10Builders - 7/10Joiners - 6/10Kitchen - 8/10Plumbing - 6/10Bathrooms - 8/10Decorators - 6/10Customer Facing Scores:Wain Homes - 7/10Sales - 7/10Site Manager - 10/10UPDATE 22/05/24Still issues so downgraded to 3 stars. Emailed Wain Homes again over a month ago asking for updates on our defective concrete slab and air bricks causing all our insulation to fall out of the cavity. They sent the insulation company round who identified the defect. MV Kelly ground workers came round and bricked up our air bricks because “we had more than we needed anyway”. I flagged this with Ken and he said he’s spoken to the building engineer who claimed we have enough air bricks and there is no issue. I asked for this in writing. Still waiting.I will be calling Wain Homes tomorrow to escalate as the current level of customer service is way below both industry standards and our expectations.

description: House Builder
title: Finding the right people makes all the difference
review: I purchased a property on the Lawton Green estate in the late third quarter of 2022. If I were writing this review a couple of months ago, I would have given Wain Homes a one star rating. Some parts of my experience with them:• The finishing of my property was rushed to meet the handover and the quality reflected that. I expected a fair few areas would need work doing, but nowhere near as many as I ended up with.• I had a handful of issues addressed in the first month or two of moving in, but then went close to six months without a single issue being addressed. I got completely ignored when attempting to contact the site manager.• The customer care team would wait multiple weeks before responding to email queries and complaints.• It took nine months of repeated emails, calls and in person chats to get them to send the referral money to my referee (As a note, I appreciated Anita’s help with this as she tried her best to get it escalated but it seemed to get stuck higher up in the chain).The only reason I’ve had a better experience recently is because of the two customer care site managers, Oliver and Sean, who took over the handling of my issues within these past couple of months. Sean took the time to go through all of my outstanding issues, reassess their current states and plan out how to tackle them. Oliver has since taken ownership of that work list, booking and chasing everything without me asking a thing. Issues are now getting fixed and he checks after each resolution to make sure I’m happy with the quality of work done. If appointments need to be rescheduled or chased then Oliver helps organise that and communicates everything, that way I’m kept informed and am able to plan around the disruptions. It makes a world of difference knowing what’s going on and I really appreciate how much he cares about getting things resolved in the best way possible. If you’re unable to interact with the right people then you’ll be left alone and in the dark chasing them to resolve the problems they’ve left you with. However, If you’re able to find those people who genuinely care about helping you then you’ll have a five star experience with Wain Homes. I wish I could give them five stars based purely off my recent experience, but the widespread communication issues across all other areas of their business can't go ignored.

description: House Builder
title: Calder View Catterall
review: Apologies for the length of this. Hopefully, it helps shed light on our experience at Calder View development and may help some people.This review could easily have been a 5* star one. Wainhomes do know how to build homes properly. They just don’t seem to be able control final finishes on so many things, but mainly on the decorating and the many sealing jobs around the home. Constantly correcting errors later-on is a weird and costly way of conducting business – and the damage to reputation is hard to calculate – compared to the old-fashioned notion of simply doing things right first-time round.We must thank Linda Collins, the salesperson who we dealt with pre-purchase, for getting WH even a 3-star review, and also Lewis the Assistant Site-manager. Without both these Wainhomes assets and their 5*+ service and attention, this would have been a 2-star rating - at best.Linda is a natural salesperson and is very honest, upfront and helpful. A people person, she has the knack of tuning into customers’ needs – and must find this job a walk-in-the-park. She was incredibly impressive. She respects people who walk into the sales office (unlike other developments). She finds out what they want – and tries her best to provide it.Lewis, assistant site-manager, is patient and listens and keeps his promises. He has a very tough job sorting out the many snags that have cropped up on our, and our neighbours’, homes. He reassures dismayed customers that things will get sorted – and they eventually do. Lewis only moved on site 3 months ago and I believe the houses being built now will not experience our issues – owing to Jim (site manager) now having Lewis to assist him. Apparently, the Site manager had no assistant up until February – which is not an ideal situation for him with such responsibility– and can lead to these quality issues.Andrew Blundell, Sales Director, was very proactive too when problems threatened the sale – and displayed his sales-skills and tenacity - by not allowing a sale to slip-away when the pre-sale shoddy workmanship came to light on the, mainly, decorating issues. We were extremely impressed with Andrew.As for other experiences - where do I start? You may well need to be prepared to encounter what we did…We love the area, development, house type and plot position. However, as for the incredible hassle pre-purchase problems themselves – as opposed to Wainhomes doing that job. It’s like playing a game that you hate. To be fair – they listened, and accepted our complaints, and did a pretty-good job of the remedial work in general. The customer-care operatives who did the snagging were, by and large, impressive.We didn’t opt for the ‘free’ solicitor offer – and chose to use, and pay for, our own. We feel that way that you aren’t being ‘looked after’ (hmmm?) by a, possibly, compliant solicitor who is being paid for by the builder. As a result, the WH solicitors were about as aggressive and obstructive as could be with our chosen solicitor - by constantly hounding us for exchange (even though we were well on-track for the agreed dates). They were very evasive with many of my solicitor’s routine legal queries that she needed to ask to protect us. They were a disgrace to their profession. I think they are more used to working hand-in hand with the compliant ‘lap-dog’ solicitors that WH foist onto purchasers (and don't ask too many questions) on their ‘free’ legal package offer'. The irony of their aggressive tactics is that they had to meekly request from us a further 2 weeks to exchange contracts because of WH failure to have the house built to standard by the original contractual dateIn the solicitor's eyes, they could do no wrong, even though they initially sent out contract documents to us 5 days later than agreed – and a contract for the wrong plot too! To compound matters, on completion day we waited for our keys for 5 hours (9.30 am - 2.30pm) on a wet, cold day - after the monies had been confirmed as received by WH’s solicitors at 9am. I think that was more of a WH legal dept. blunder though to be honest - or maybe a collaborated effort? Does it really matter?All in all, I’m glad we stuck with it and were tenacious and demanding. On a positive note, we have found WH to be responsive to all issues and are very approachable people as a rule. We haven't found them 'nasty or evil' as some allude to on here.I wish we could have sincerely given 5 stars – but we can’t.I think Wainhomes do make the business of selling houses a lot harder for them than it need be.
