review: Had a rough start with customer service. However once we received the keys and in the care of Ryan (site manager), our experience turned into a more pleasant one. He has been and continues to be of good service. He knows his stuff and has helped us a lot since.

description: House Builder
title: poor quality standard at Kingsley manor
review: Off to great start with sales and marketing - very disappointing on completion , house a mess damaged kitchen bathroom woodwork  plaster radiators windows and external stonework brickwork garden gate and faulty boiler ..I could go on ..4th site manager since November ..total lack of communication ..no gives a toss about our problems ..passes from pillar to post, massive stress and reported numerous times and know ones really cares - very disappointing to say the least for an expensive house that states they have excellent quality finish is far from it

description: House Builder
title: Dont want to fix snags &  Slow communication
review: i have been in my house now for nearly 18 months now and our snags are still on going but now as the 2 year time frame is coming to an end we are struggling to get wainhomes to actually fix the outstanding snags. one main one being the paint work. it was absolutely shoddy like a child had painted the stairs, 3 decorators have been back and some how keep missing the actual problems and this last time the paint doesnt even match. wainhomes have come back and said because it has been patched up at different times they wont be able to get it to match so they can no longer help. so we are now left with patches on our skirting boards, stairs and door frames which wainhomes wont fix even though they knew about all the snagging problems within 1 week of us moving in. i have paint splashes on my kitchen floor but no one has managed to get off yet. the cistern lids on 2 of the toilets dont fit correctly and wobble constantly but wainhomes have said this can not be fixed.we have now noticed corrosion on a radiator which isnt even 2 years old yet so dread to think how they will last. i feel like customer services have been told to keep them waiting till after 2 years and then its not their problem any more. ive never come across a company with such bad customer service, it can take months before anyone contacts back and its usually not helpful when they do.

description: House Builder
title: Nightmare
review: Bought a wain home on Pinfold Manor, where do I start. Quality of build very good, finishing very poor and after service atrocious. No gas when we moved in for 3 days due to a gas leak. House was filthy, flies everywhere.Still surrounded by a building site 6 months later.once they get your money you are at the mercy of organized chaos ..be warned!

description: House Builder

review: We bought a house over 7 years ago on the Hillcrest /Miners View development in Up Holland and we are still waiting for the estate roads to be finished off. We have raised the issue via the customer care email address a number of times over the years but there is always an excuse. They blame the delay is due to Council, the council say it’s Wainhomes. Either way it is unacceptable to be living here FOR SEVEN YEARS on an unfinished development with no firm completion date. I highly doubt I’d buy a new build Wainhomes house in future for this reason alone!

We are constantly chasing complaints/concerns raised, and get no response. As soon as we got the keys and moved in to the property, we were let down!

At the time of purchase  I was advised that Wain Homes were scheduled to return and complete the road into the estate. This has not happened and we have had excuse after excuse . It is not only an eyesore but a risk if you are walking along the road surface. I can provide photographic evidence if required.

review: Although the house itself is great with all initial new build problems addressed in a timely and fair manner, We are approaching 7+ years and the estates main access is still incomplete. Like some of the recent reviews, it looks like everyone has finally had enough with the excuses that have been made by Wain homes - it's time for action to actually 'finish' the new build estate.A side note to dealing with Wain homes, It felt underhanded and sneaky how after less than two years of being in our new home that Wain homes had already managed to sell on our properties' leasehold without offering the chance to buy it out ourselves, prior to selling to on to a private group.

description: House Builder
title: Bad after care
review: Soo many new developments happening yet our development (Hillcrest) from over 7 years ago still hasn’t been finished. Over 7 years on and our road is still yet to be completed. Excuse after excuse. Come on wainhomes.

description: House Builder
title: Customer care rubbish & poor quality finish
review: Bought a Nelson in September and still waiting for snagging to be done. the paintwork looks like a child has done it, woodwork looks like it wasn't dusted off before painting so everywhere is rough and the stairs looks like the paint has just been slapped on and allowed to dribble all over and bits missed. decorators have been back 3 times already and still havent sorted it out. the wainhomes technician thought it was fine to fix the wobbly lid to the toilet unit by using  silicone to glue it down so we cant take the lid off if there was ever a problem. the customer care team dont actually care as they never get back to you even if you include the CEO in as well. ive been waiting for a replacement carpet in my entrance hall since october but still not got it and my front door needed realigning as wasnt fitted correctly and the plaster work and paint work around the door was damaged... customer service team first refused to fix the problem then said " as a gesture of good will we will fix it." still waiting for the paint work on this to be done. there are many more problems but over all the after care isnt the best. spoken to our neighbours and they all seem to get things thrown in to keep them quiet eg a door fitted under the stairs and turf in their back garden but we never got anything,  just time wasted off work to let people in and out of the house.

description: House Builder
title: Marton Meadows, Blackpool
review: Well, I am now a year on from completing on my home which, to be honest, was built to a reasonable standard with no major defects (up to now after 1 year in the property, fingers crossed).My major issue is around the final completion of the site, or should I say the complete lack of site completion.I live in the final phase of the development but despite actual building construction finishing 6 months ago, there are still major issues to be completed on-site, including: -1)  The laying of the actual road surface to replace the temporary road surface we are left with on the MAJOR through road across the whole site.  This makes it impossible to keep property and vehicles clean as the road is just constantly dusty or muddy depending on the weather and season.2) Constant issues of vehicle tyres being punctured due to building debris (e.g. screws & nails) being left in most places.3) Not all the planned 'open areas' are complete or even properly maintained e.g. still some sort of site yard fenced off which is still used by contractors who appear on site intermittently.4) Obvious major issues with road main drainage & sewers as the main through road (see point 1 above) continues to have regular 'inspections' followed by excavations and work at each sewer drain point.We now discover that Wainhomes are planning a 'mirror' development site directly oppositive ours at Marton Meadows for another 350 homes.  The intention is to make them two halves of a much larger planned development?I suggest Wainhomes complete the outstanding work on the first site before trying to start the second development.

Just dont buy of these awefull usless builders.

To make matters worse the box had been opened and the contents thoroughly explored even down to opening the small boxes/bags inside and the parcel was dumped open end down in a puddle and the instruction manual was floating in the same puddle having fallen out. The manual is fortunately available online so no big deal and it appears that everything has been delivered. I would have refused delivery if the courier had knocked but I opened the door just in time to see him drive off down the road. I would make a couple of suggestions:1. Package the goods in something that obscures the nature of the contents: sending expensive items out in the original manufacturer's box is inviting investigation by the unscrupulous. A bit of brown paper and parcel tape won't break the bank and can be recycled with the cardboard box.2. Use a courier that takes a bit more pride in their customer service.In view of the recent bad weather I have not had the chance to use my purchase yet, but hopefully all will be complete and work satisfactorily when I do.

Delivery was very quick, so no complaints there.

title: First time order
review: Ordered some sealant for our porch, first time ordering with Dortech Direct. Quick delivery but the sealant that I recieved had expired in August and not useable for the job. Spoke to Customer services and it transpired that Dortech were selling some clearly marked expired products on a clearance section. I send them a screenshot of my order and explained that nothing had shown up on screen during the ordering process on the website and I would not have ordered it otherwise. Customer services were understanding of my situation and kindly agreed to refund the order without having to post it back. I am still waiting on my refund which is taking some time but when I recieve it, I would upgrade to 5 stars and would order from Dortech Direct again for future DIY projects.Update: Refund recieved, 5 stars for customer service!

title: Glitchy ordering and don't bank on a timely delivery!!
review: I struggled to order sheet materials online as the glitchy checkout system first of all insisted that my delivery address was different from my basket address - it wasn't.  Then it refused to record my shipping address correctly on my order.  One of my two stars goes to the Online Chat lady who ended up adding a note to my order to ensure the delivery came to the correct address, not a similar address up the road.I ordered on Tuesday 20/8/24, with a quoted delivery of 2-3 days.  I therefore expected delivery by Friday 23/8/24 afternoon latest, and booked labour accordingly.  Friday afternoon I received an email saying that because of the following Bank Holiday Monday on 26/8/24, my order wouldn't be delivered until Wednesday 28/8/24.  I mean, really?  You quote 2-3 working days but actually manage considerably worse.  That's pretty hopeless in terms of delivering a decent, timely service to the customer, and a huge frustration to me in having to cancel labour - at a cost to me  - and annoying delay getting an urgent job done in a decent timescale.The second star is for the delivery driver who was absolutely excellent and very helpful.
